We first build an evaluation set automatically, mining OpenReview for passages where reviewers explicitly affirm or dispute a paper's originality and keeping only submissions with unanimous agreement at the extremes of their research area; we pair these with ideas from a vanilla LLM generator. Across six judges, we find that small prompt design choices have large consequences; e.g., simply telling the judge that reviewers found one idea novel and the other not can change its verdict on more than half of the identical idea pairs it is shown, shifting pairwise accuracy by over 50 points and occasionally pushing it below chance. The same change helps one judge and hurts another. Retrieval and larger reasoning budgets help little, and two purpose-built novelty evaluators are outperformed by our cheapest prompted baseline. These results raise questions about reported novelty gains of automated ideation systems, and call for robust novelty evaluation methods.

</details>


### [277] [Typological Alignment of Stack-Based Language Models on Mildly Context-Sensitive Artificial Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02040)
*Nadine El-Naggar,Tatsuki Kuribayashi,Ted Briscoe*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过跨序列依赖和栈式语言模型(SLM)扩展了对LM学习偏差与语言类型共性关系的分析，发现SLM对跨序列依赖泛化困难，但有限工作记忆的SLM泛化更好，或为词序偏好提供归纳偏差基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言类型共性（如SOV词序更普遍）常被归因于学习偏差。已有工作用语言模型研究此理论，本文旨在从数据和模型两侧进一步扩展，聚焦跨序列依赖（句法复杂度上限）与栈式语言模型（利于层级模式学习）。

Method: 评估栈式语言模型(SLM)在多种人工语言上对跨序列依赖的泛化能力，并考察工作记忆容量（受限与否）对泛化的影响。

Result: SLM对跨序列依赖泛化表现困难，难以习得此类构式；但工作记忆受限的SLM泛化反而更好。

Conclusion: 工作记忆限制可能构成一种归纳偏差的基础，从而解释某些词序配置在自然语言中的类型共性。

Abstract: Some properties of languages, e.g., subject-object-verb (SOV) word order, are more prevalent than others among the thousands of attested natural languages (NLs). Such typological commonality is often attributed to learning biases. Computational simulations, recently with language models (LMs), have facilitated the exploration of this theory. In this paper, we extend existing analyses of the relationship between LMs' learning biases and typological commonality on both data and model sides, focusing on: (i) cross-serial dependencies, the upper limit of attested syntactic complexity, and (ii) stack-based LMs (SLMs), potentially facilitating learning of hierarchical patterns. We first evaluate generalization of SLMs on cross-serial dependencies across diverse artificial languages and confirm that they struggle with such constructions. However, SLMs with limited working memory generalize better suggesting a possible basis for such inductive bias and thus the typological commonality of some word order configurations.

</details>


### [278] [LLM2Jev: LLMs Are Already Jev-Style Decision Models -- When and How to Fine-Tune Them](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02076)
*Yinheng Li,Justin Wagle*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 LLM2Jev，一种不改变架构的框架，直接从 LLM 下一个 token 概率中提取校准决策，并研究通用 LLM 是否已原生具备 Jev 式决策能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Jev 式决策模型能输出类别概率分布供软件直接使用，但需专门训练；作者想探究通用 LLM 是否已具备此能力，以及何时真正需要微调。

Method: LLM2Jev 从括号数字标识的下一个 token 概率中提取决策，含免训练推理方案；微调目标采用树因子化 listwise 损失优化候选选择，并用 KL 散度惩罚将辅助预测锚定到基础模型。

Result: 在 Qwen3.5-4B 和 Qwen3-0.6B 上验证：4B 模型免训练即可匹敌同骨干社区 Jev 模型，优于字母 logit 读取，支持任意选项数与原生的多模态图像决策。微调对弱模型和特定任务（如多选项意图路由）提升明显，但对强骨干收益递减。KL 锚可有效防止对话文本生成能力退化，LoRA 在强模型上表现最佳。

Conclusion: 现代 LLM 本身已是有效的决策模型，微调带来的是针对性而非普遍性收益，且需通过 KL 锚避免行为退化。

Abstract: Jev-style decision models return categorical probability distributions over predefined options without generating free-form text, enabling software systems to act on their outputs directly. In this work, we investigate the extent to which general-purpose LLMs already possess this capability out of the box, and when fine-tuning is actually necessary. We present LLM2Jev, an architecture-preserving framework that extracts calibrated decisions directly from next-token probabilities over bracketed numeric identifiers. LLM2Jev provides both a training-free inference recipe and a fine-tuning objective that optimizes candidate selection via a tree-factorized listwise loss while anchoring auxiliary predictions to the base model using KL divergence penalties. Evaluating on Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3-0.6B, we find that modern LLMs are inherently effective decision models: without training, the 4B model matches community Jev-style models built on the same backbone, outperforms letter-logit readouts, supports arbitrary option counts, and natively handles multimodal decisions over images. Fine-tuning provides targeted rather than universal benefits -- substantially improving weaker models and specific tasks (such as many-option intent routing), but offering diminishing returns for strong backbones. Crucially, our KL anchors prevent behavioral degradation in conversational text generation, with LoRA delivering the strongest performance on capable models.

</details>


### [279] [Scalable, Transferable Meta-network for Data Selection Requires a Different Loss (and Why the Obvious Choice is Problematic)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02092)
*Zilin Du,Bowen Yang,Boyang Albert Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出TESS框架，基于Pointwise Value Matching目标实现可迁移的数据选择，解决选择网络优化不稳定和泛化差的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型训练需要从海量异构语料中选数据。现有元学习数据选择方法在细粒度估值与向未见数据的可迁移性之间存在权衡。用选择网络替代逐样本权重是自然方案，但直接嵌入现有MTS目标会导致优化不稳定和泛化差，根源是权重抑制与对易学特征的持续依赖。

Method: 提出TESS（Transferable Example Scoring and Selection），一个可扩展的数据选择框架，构建在Pointwise Value Matching（PVM）目标之上。

Result: 在LLM安全和定向指令微调任务上，TESS展现出强迁移能力：跨数据集、从子集到全语料、以及从小模型到大模型。

Conclusion: TESS通过PVM目标有效解决选择网络的不稳定与泛化问题，实现可迁移的数据选择。

Abstract: Data selection is critical for training large language models on massive and heterogeneous corpora. Meta-learning for Training-data Selection offers a principled alternative to heuristic scoring by learning data weights from a target validation objective, but existing methods face a trade-off between fine-grained valuation and transferability to unseen data. A natural solution is to replace per-sample weights with a selection network. However, we find that directly incorporating such a network into existing MTS objectives leads to unstable optimization and poor generalization, caused by weight suppression and persistent reliance on easy-to-learn features. To address these issues, we propose Transferable Example Scoring and Selection (TESS), a scalable data-selection framework built on a Pointwise Value Matching objective (PVM). Experiments on LLM safety and targeted instruction tuning demonstrate strong transfer across datasets, from subsets to full corpora, and from smaller to larger models.

</details>


### [280] [Argo-Bench: Evaluating Data Agents on Enterprise-Scale Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02122)
*Gabriel Tomitsuka,Arman Raayatsanati,Emma Xing,Duke Gand,Joseph J Ma*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Argo-Bench，含 210 个数据科学与分析任务，模拟纽约外卖平台，导出 235 表 7.5 亿行仓库，评分基于模拟器后果，最强模型仅 34.8% 任务达标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 text-to-SQL 基准仅评测查询生成且答案常错误；因企业仓库敏感只能用公共单表数据集，无法反映真实需跨多表推理、统计分析并据结果行动的工作流。

Method: 基于公开数据、行业文献与监管文件构建纽约外卖平台模拟器（2024 年 8100 万订单，含经济、欺诈与市场激励），导出为仿 Oracle E-Business Suite 的 235 表、75 亿行 ERP 仓库；真值状态对 agent 隐藏，任务需先导航仓库重建事实再行动；agent 执行封禁欺诈账户、分配激励预算、补发工资等动作，评分依据其在模拟器中的后果；每题配有可执行参考解。

Result: 14 个前沿与开源模型中表现最佳者仅 34.8% 任务得分≥95，平均 59.5 分。

Conclusion: Argo-Bench 超越 text-to-SQL，推动能理解、导航并在真实数据环境中行动的 agent 研究。

Abstract: Real-world enterprise data science and analytics workflows require reasoning across dozens of tables, performing statistical analyses, and acting on the results. Established text-to-SQL benchmarks evaluate query generation alone, and audits have found their answer keys frequently wrong. Because real enterprise warehouses are too sensitive to release, these benchmarks are built on public datasets where a business event fits in a single table. We introduce Argo-Bench, an evaluation framework comprising 210 data science and analytics tasks. Drawing on public data, peer-reviewed industry literature, and regulatory filings, we simulate a food delivery platform in New York City at true scale, with 81 million orders in 2024, grounded economics, fraud patterns, and marketplace incentives. We export this world to an ERP warehouse of 235 tables and 7.5 billion rows, modeled on the Oracle E-Business Suite schema. The simulator's ground-truth state is withheld from the warehouse the agent sees, so tasks require reconstructing facts by navigating the warehouse before acting on them. Argo-Bench goes beyond text-to-SQL: the agent files actions such as banning fraudulent accounts, allocating courier incentive budgets, or issuing back pay, and the grader scores each by its consequences in the simulator. Every task has an executable reference solution that demonstrates solvability using only the warehouse. The strongest of 14 frontier and open-weight models scores 95 or higher on only 34.8% of tasks and averages 59.5 points. We hope Argo-Bench drives progress toward agents that understand, navigate, and act within real data environments.

</details>


### [281] [Keyword Harnesses Fail Open: A Cheap Diagnostic Ladder for Tool-Use Claims in Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02142)
*Juan S. Santillana*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 关键词匹配型工具调用基准会误判小模型能力：同架构西班牙语安全模型中，1B模型宽松指标与600M相当（B4 0.650 vs 0.660），但严格复现检查显示1B完全失败（0/6 vs 6/6）。定位为web-heavy训练阶段抹除了<|tool_call|>先验，仅~3.3 GPU小时的目标SFT即可修复，并提出廉价诊断阶梯用于把关工具使用声明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关键词匹配评测可能给从未真正执行工具调用的小模型"记功"，导致工具使用能力被高估。作者希望通过一对匹配架构的西班牙语安全模型记录这一假阳性，并提供严格、低成本的诊断方法。

Method: 对比661.6M（约65%代码/技术文本，无专用SFT）与1,109M（web-heavy多阶段课程+6B token工具SFT）模型，二者共享decoder、tokenizer与特殊token。采用逐字复现检查、首token概率探针、嵌入漂移检查与因子分析等诊断手段，并用目标SFT配方（多样语料、5倍学习率、2202步、约3.3 GPU小时）修复1B模型。

Result: 宽松指标下两模型近乎相同（B4 0.660 vs 0.650）；逐字复现中600M在6/6样本生成有效工具调用，1B在0/6。首token探针将1B失败定位为<|tool_call|>先验缺失（概率10^-4~10^-5），系web-heavy阶段抹除。修复后269行有效发射率从0.100升至0.959（600M 0.926），238个未见提示上修复1B达0.536 vs 600M 0.428（p=0.004）。嵌入漂移显示触发器token的绑定嵌入未改变（97.7% bf16表逐位相同）。两模型均过度触发（负样本无调用率0.09与0.17）。

Conclusion: 廉价诊断阶梯（数分钟CPU）可揭示关键词基准的假阳性，应作为小模型工具使用声明的准入门槛。修复成本极低，说明问题源于先验被抹除而非架构缺陷；但抑制过度触发是否受益于多样语料仍因种子敏感性而属假设。

Abstract: Keyword-matching benchmarks can credit small models for tool use they never perform. We document such a false positive in a matched-architecture pair of Spanish security language models and propose a ladder of strict, cheap diagnostics. A 661.6M parameter model (approx. 65% code/technical text; no dedicated SFT) and a 1,109M model (web-heavy multi-phase curriculum; 6B-token tool-SFT) share decoder, tokenizer, and special tokens, scoring almost identically on lenient tool-use metrics (B4: 0.660 vs. 0.650).
  Verbatim-reproduction checks on training examples separate them completely: the 600M emits valid tool calls with generalized arguments on 6/6 examples; the 1B does so on 0/6 across checkpoints. A first-token probe localizes the 1B's failure to a missing prior (prob. $10^{-4}$--$10^{-5}$ on <|tool_call|>), which was erased by its web-heavy training phase. A targeted SFT recipe (diverse corpus, 5x higher learning rate, 2,202 steps, ~3.3 GPU-hours) repairs the 1B using three orders of magnitude fewer tokens than the failed phase. On all 269 corpus rows, valid emission rises from 0.100 to 0.959 (600M: 0.926). On 238 unseen prompts, the repaired 1B passes 0.536 vs. the 600M's 0.428 ($p = 0.004$). Embedding-drift checks show the repair did not move the trigger token's tied embedding (97.7% of the bf16 table remains bit-identical), meaning changes live in the surrounding network.
  Both models over-trigger, rarely answering negative prompts without a call (0.09 for 600M, 0.17 for repaired 1B). Factorial analyses confirm all repair configurations install the format, though suppression benefits from a diverse corpus remain a hypothesis due to seed sensitivity. This cheap diagnostic ladder costs minutes of CPU time and should gate tool-use claims on small models.

</details>


### [282] [From Knowledge Access to Source Learning: Developing Source-Specific Competence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02150)
*Lucheng Fu,Kejing Xia,Yiyang Wang,Yiqiao Jin,Jinjin He,Xiyuan Yang,Haoxin Liu,Ye Yu,Haibo Jin,Yijia Xiao,Wenke Lee,B. Aditya Prakash,Haohan Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出SourceLearn，将持久外部源的反复使用视为逐步学习机会，通过持久源模型与两种学习机制提升知识密集型任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体常用持久外部源完成知识密集任务，但现有方法将同一源的重复使用仅视为反复访问，未利用其逐步深化理解的机会。

Method: 提出持久源模型表示可复用的源理解，并通过SourceLearn结合两种机制：自导向源学习识别理解不足之处并自适应重访源；任务导向源学习利用下游经验发现表征缺口与组织需求，且由权威源重建持久更新。

Result: 在5个基准、3个LLM后端上，SourceLearn在15个设置中13个取得最佳表现，较Hybrid RAG最高提升22.6分，并优于静态源表示与经验记忆基线。

Conclusion: 将持久源作为可逐步学习的对象，可显著提升源特定能力与下游任务表现。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on persistent external sources to solve sequences of knowledge-intensive tasks. Existing methods improve how source content is accessed and organized, while agent-memory systems preserve reusable knowledge from prior interactions, but repeated use of the same source is still largely treated as repeated access rather than an opportunity to progressively improve understanding of that source. We study source learning: developing reusable source-specific competence over a persistent authoritative source. We represent this competence with a persistent source model that captures reusable understanding of the source, including how its knowledge is structured, interpreted, and applied. To construct and progressively refine such models, we propose SourceLearn, which combines two complementary learning mechanisms. Self-Directed Source Learning identifies what remains incompletely understood and adaptively revisits the source, while Task-Guided Source Learning uses downstream experience to reveal local representational gaps and recurring needs in how source knowledge should be organized. In both cases, learning signals determine what should be reconsidered, while persistent updates are reconstructed from the authoritative source. Across five benchmarks and three LLM backends, SourceLearn achieves the best performance in 13 of 15 settings, with gains of up to 22.6 points over Hybrid RAG and substantial overall improvements over static source representations and experience-based memory baselines.

</details>


### [283] [AutoCompact: Learning When to Compact Context in Long-Horizon Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02163)
*Xuan Zhang,Longtao Zheng,Cunxiao Du,Bo An,Xin Dong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AutoCompact 训练编码智能体将上下文压缩决策纳入策略，通过监督微调与强化学习联合优化，显著提升任务通过率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长轨迹任务中早期探索会过时，上下文管理不仅是防溢出，还需决定何时压缩、保留哪些工作状态以及如何续接。现有方法未将压缩决策作为策略的一部分来学习。

Method: 在编码任务上运行基础智能体，用评判器审查其压缩决策、摘要及压缩后动作；将缺陷输出替换为修正版本并在环境中执行，使轨迹从修正决策继续。用这些轨迹做监督微调，再用任务成功奖励进行强化学习，联合优化编码与压缩能力。

Result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 和 SWE-PolyBench Verified 上，相比基础模型通过率分别绝对提升 9.2% 和 5.0%；改进在所有评估推理预算下均成立，256K 上下文窗口下从不溢出，16K 窗口溢出时触发回退压缩。

Conclusion: 将上下文压缩作为策略学习的一部分可有效提升仓库级编码智能体的表现，并适配不同上下文窗口预算。

Abstract: Coding agents solve repository-level software engineering tasks through long trajectories of code inspection, search, editing, and testing. As a task progresses, earlier exploration becomes stale, so managing context is more than avoiding overflow: an agent must decide when to compact, what working state to preserve, and how to continue from it. We introduce AutoCompact, which trains a coding agent to make these decisions as part of its policy. To collect training data, we run the base agent on coding tasks and use a judge to review its compaction decisions, summaries, and actions after compaction. Flawed outputs are replaced with corrected ones before being executed in the environment, so each trajectory continues from the corrected decisions. We use these trajectories for supervised fine-tuning, then jointly optimize coding and compaction through reinforcement learning with task-success rewards. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-PolyBench Verified show that AutoCompact improves pass rates over the base model by an absolute 9.2\% and 5.0\%, respectively. The improvements hold across all evaluated inference budgets, with a 256K context window that never overflows and with a 16K window whose overflow triggers fallback compaction.

</details>


### [284] [Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02193)
*Hui Ren,Zihan Li,Chang Liu,Huidong Liu,Alexander Schwing*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: HC-DLM 提出一种分层连续扩散语言模型，将离散 token 生成与连续隐变量轨迹耦合在统一去噪过程中，训练目标源于 token 似然的变分下界，在数独、Countdown 和 LM1B 上优于离散与连续扩散基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散语言模型并行解码时各 token 独立采样于边缘分布，破坏了同批解码 token 间的统计依赖；连续扩散虽用共享连续状态去噪，但其去噪器仅见该状态，最终解码前无法保证与有效 token 配置绑定。

Method: 提出 Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models（HC-DLM），将离散 token 生成与连续隐变量轨迹在单一、有原则的去噪过程中耦合，训练目标由 token 似然的变分下界推导。与将连续上下文附加到自洽离散链的方法不同，HC-DLM 让隐变量成为唯一持久的生成状态：每步从中读出 token，并作为下一隐变量更新的脚手架反馈。

Result: 在结构化推理（Sudoku）、数学规划（Countdown）和语言建模（LM1B）任务上，同等模型规模下 HC-DLM 超越离散与连续扩散基线：Sudoku 和 Countdown 的谜题准确率提升，LM1B 上生成困惑度改善。

Conclusion: HC-DLM 通过以连续隐变量为唯一持久生成状态、将离散 token 读取并反馈，实现对离散与连续扩散局限的统一解决，在多个任务上验证了有效性。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion language models offer a compelling alternative to autoregressive generation for tasks demanding bidirectional reasoning and global constraint satisfaction. Yet they share a structural bottleneck: when decoding in parallel, each token is sampled independently from its marginal, severing the statistical dependencies among the tokens decoded together. Continuous diffusion language models avoid this by denoising a shared continuous state, but their denoiser sees only that state, so nothing ties it to a valid token configuration until it is finally decoded. To address this, we propose Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models (HC-DLM), which couple discrete token generation with a continuous latent trajectory in a single, principled denoising process, whose training objective is derived from a variational bound on the token likelihood. In contrast to recent methods that attach continuous context to a self-contained discrete chain, HC-DLM makes the latent the only persistent generative state: tokens are read out from it at every step and feed back as a scaffold for the next latent update. On structured reasoning (Sudoku), mathematical planning (Countdown) and language modeling (LM1B), HC-DLM improves over discrete and continuous diffusion baselines at matched model size, in puzzle accuracy on Sudoku and Countdown and in generative perplexity on LM1B. Project page: https://hc-dlm.github.io/.

</details>


### [285] [KaliBench: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Cybersecurity Tool Use on Kali Linux with Runtime-Free Verifiable Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02206)
*Pengfei Li,Naufal Suryanto,Sicheng Zhang,Muzammal Naseer*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: KaliBench是一个针对Kali Linux自然语言到命令行翻译的细粒度基准与数据集，覆盖8504对查询-命令、1642个工具，揭示现有模型在无提示下生成可执行CLI命令能力不足，并支持可验证奖励训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM越来越多用于网络安全工作流，需将分析师意图转为工具调用，但现有评估要么侧重知识问答，要么端到端智能体任务，未直接测量生成真实网络安全工具可执行命令的能力。而CLI对语法、flag-value绑定、参数顺序极敏感，微小错误即导致执行失败，这一能力缺口至关重要。

Method: 构建KaliBench：基于文稿驱动的流水线，采用确定性规范化与别名感知评估，含8504查询-命令对、1642个工具、23个能力维度、5个安全阶段。通过多阶段验证流水线（LLM验证+沙箱终端执行+人在回路精炼）保证语义正确与可执行性。基于细粒度确定性信号支持免运行时的可验证奖励训练。

Result: 在3种评估模式、24种配置的通用及安全专用开放权重模型上，无限制设置下无开放权重模型超过42%精确命令准确率；说明缺乏工具提示时准确使用网络安全CLI工具难度高。使用KaliBench导出的可验证奖励进行SFT与RL，可显著提升8B模型，达到接近685B MoE模型的性能。

Conclusion: KaliBench填补了自然语言到网络安全工具CLI翻译评估的空白，提供细粒度、可复现、可执行的基准与数据集，并可作为训练信号；实验表明当前开放权重模型在该任务上仍有明显不足，而基于该基准的SFT/RL能大幅提升小模型表现。

Abstract: LLMs are increasingly applied to cybersecurity workflows, where they are expected to translate analysts' intent into tool invocations. However, existing evaluations focus on knowledge-based assessments or end-to-end agentic tasks, and do not directly measure LLMs' ability to generate executable commands for real-world cybersecurity tools. This gap is critical because cybersecurity operations rely on strict command-line interfaces (CLIs), where minor syntax errors, incorrect flag--value bindings, or argument misordering can invalidate execution. We introduce KaliBench, a fine-grained benchmark and dataset for natural-language--to--CLI translation on Kali Linux, comprising 8,504 query--command pairs spanning 1,642 tools across 23 capability dimensions and 5 security phases. KaliBench is constructed via a manuscript-grounded pipeline with deterministic canonicalization and alias-aware evaluation, enabling precise and reproducible assessment of tool selection and argument construction. To ensure both semantic correctness and practical executability, we develop a multi-stage verification pipeline that combines LLM-based validation, sandboxed terminal execution, and human-in-the-loop refinement. Building on these fine-grained, deterministic signals, KaliBench further enables runtime-free verifiable rewards for training. Across three evaluation modes and 24 configurations of general-purpose and security-focused open-weight models, no open-weight model exceeds 42% exact-command accuracy in the unrestricted setting, highlighting the difficulty of accurate CLI-based cybersecurity tool use without explicit tool hints. We further show that supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards derived from KaliBench significantly improve an 8B model and achieve performance comparable to a 685B MoE model.

</details>


<div id='cs.GT'></div>

# cs.GT [[Back]](#toc)

### [286] [When Maximum Nash Welfare Becomes Strongly Fair: Bi-valued Goods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00122)
*Zehan Lin,Xiaowei Wu,Shengwei Zhou*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究不可分物品的公平分配，对(个性化)二值实例中MNW分配的EFX、PMMS、GMMS近似保证给出了紧刻画，并证明三值实例中MNW的公平性保证会显著恶化，从而划定了MNW强公平性的清晰边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MNW在一般加性估值下具有EF1与PO的良好性质，且在二值、双值实例中已知满足EFX、GMMS等强公平性。作者希望精确刻画MNW在(个性化)二值实例中对EFX、PMMS、GMMS的近似保证，并探究这一强公平性在稍加推广(三值)后是否仍然成立。

Method: 本文重新审视(个性化)二值实例，对MNW分配关于EFX、PMMS与GMMS的近似保证进行紧刻画；同时考察稍更一般化的三值实例，分析MNW公平性保证的变化。

Result: 对二值实例给出了MNW在EFX、PMMS、GMMS上的紧近似保证，显著强于一般估值下的已知结果；并证明在三值实例中，MNW的公平性保证会显著恶化。

Conclusion: MNW分配的强公平性仅适用于二值(及双值)这一受限实例类，三值实例即出现明显退化，由此确定了MNW具有强公平性的实例的清晰边界。

Abstract: For the fair allocation of indivisible goods, the milestone work of Caragiannis et al. (2019) revolutionized the understanding of Maximum Nash Welfare (MNW) allocations by revealing their "unreasonable" ability to balance fairness (EF1) and efficiency (PO) for general additive functions. Subsequent work established that MNW allocations simultaneously satisfy EFX and GMMS (and consequently MMS and PMMS) for binary instances (Amanatidis et al. 2021 and Barman et al. 2018), and satisfy EFX for bi-valued instances (Amanatidis et al. 2021). In this paper, we revisit the (personalized) bi-valued instances and provide a tight characterization of the approximation guarantees of MNW allocations with respect to EFX, PMMS, and GMMS, showing that these guarantees are significantly stronger than what is known for general valuations. Furthermore, we demonstrate that even for the slightly more general setting of tri-valued instances, the fairness guarantees of MNW deteriorate significantly, which establishes a sharp boundary on the instances for which MNW allocations are strongly fair.

</details>


### [287] [Maximin Share Allocations Beyond Weakly Lexicographic Valuations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00159)
*Nicholas Teh*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 该论文研究不可分物品在非负加性估值下的公平分配，证明了一类广义少值域与弱字典序估值存在精确MMS分配，并给出多项式时间算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MMS分配的存在性在一般加性估值下不成立，已有结果多局限于特定少值域。作者希望统一并推广这些少值域以及弱字典序估值，寻找更广的、可保证精确MMS分配存在的估值域。

Method: 对每个代理，将低值物品经正放缩后取值限制在 {0,1,d,d+1}、{0,1,2,2e} 或 {0,1,2,3,4}（d,e≥2为整数）；其上可含任意多值类，但每类中单个物品价值至少等于所有严格更低值物品总价值。值类、放缩因子和参数可因代理而异。作者设计算法构造MMS分配。

Result: 证明上述估值域中精确MMS分配必然存在，并给出时间复杂度为 O(nm log²(2+m)) 的算法，其中 n 为代理数，m 为物品数。

Conclusion: 该工作推广了多个少值域及弱字典序估值的MMS存在性结果，并提供高效构造算法，加深了对MMS可保证性的理解。

Abstract: We study the fair division of indivisible goods among agents with nonnegative additive valuations. An agent's maximin share (MMS) is the value she can guarantee by partitioning the goods into as many bundles as there are agents and receiving a least-valued bundle. We prove the existence of exact MMS allocations for a valuation domain that generalizes several few-valued domains as well as weakly lexicographic valuations. For each agent, the lower-valued goods, after a positive rescaling, may take values in $\{0,1,d,d+1\}$, $\{0,1,2,2e\}$, or $\{0,1,2,3,4\}$, where $d,e\ge 2$ are integers. Above these goods, the valuation may contain arbitrarily many value classes, subject to the condition that a single good in each class is worth at least the total value of all strictly lower-valued goods. The value classes, scaling factors, and parameters may vary across agents. We give an algorithm that computes an MMS allocation in $O(nm\log^2(2+m))$ time, where $n$ is the number of agents and $m$ is the number of goods.

</details>


### [288] [Forming Alliances in the Fog of War: A General Lotto Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00608)
*Edik Hakobyan,Vade Shah,Jason R. Marden*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究在联盟型General Lotto博弈中，预算信息不确定时是否仍存在对双方都有利的预算转移联盟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实中agents面对共同对手时可通过结盟获益，但往往缺乏对对手或盟友预算的精确知识，需要研究不确定性对联盟形成的影响。

Method: 在coalitional General Lotto game中建模，两玩家分别将资源预算分配到各自的有价值contest上对抗共同对手。考虑两种不确定性模型：一是对对手预算不确定，二是对彼此预算不确定，均以乘法因子刻画，并分析在玩家所猜想可能的所有博弈中都有效（鲁棒）的转移。

Result: 精确刻画了哪些博弈在两种不确定性模型下存在使双方均受益的鲁棒预算转移；并证明对任意不确定性水平，这类鲁棒转移存在于正测度的博弈集合中。

Conclusion: 即使盟友对相关预算信息几乎一无所知，联盟（预算转移）仍可能值得形成。

Abstract: Agents competing against a common opponent can often gain an edge by forming alliances, but deciding whether to do so is difficult when they lack precise knowledge about their opponent or ally. We study how uncertainty affects opportunities for alliance formation in the coalitional General Lotto game, in which two players compete aganist a shared adversary by allocating their resource budgets over separate sets of valued contests. When all agents know one another's budgets, it is known that a budget transfer from one player to the other can benefit both players. We ask whether such alliances survive when the players know the relevant budgets only up to a multiplicative factor. Under two models, one in which the players are uncertain about the adversary's budget and one in which they are uncertain about each other's budgets, we characterize exactly which games admit a transfer that benefits both players in every game consistent with what they conjecture to be possible. In both models, we show that such robust transfers exist in a set of games of positive measure for every level of uncertainty. These results suggest that alliances can remain worthwhile even when allies are largely in the dark.

</details>


### [289] [Bandwidth Fee Mechanisms for Certified Transaction Dissemination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00697)
*Eleftheria Fassman,Mahimna Kelkar,Benjamin Marsh,Ke Wu*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究带宽费用机制（BFM），为共识前的门槛认证交易传播定价，建模为用户与验证者之间的双边采购拍卖，并分析激励相容的极限、可行的贪婪路由明价机制以及跨区块的EIP-1559式定价规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交易费用机制主要针对计算定价，而区块链通信（传播）同样需要定价，尤其是在传播与共识、执行分离的架构下。因此需要专门研究带宽费用机制。

Method: 将BFM建模为提交交易的用户与接收并转发交易的验证者之间的双边采购拍卖：任意验证者可充当源并转发至门槛数量的attester，模型考虑用户付费与验证者间转账，但抽象掉多跳gossip与网络拓扑。同时提出贪婪路由明价机制，并设计EIP-1559式跨区块价格更新规则及其流体近似分析。

Result: 证明了短视激励相容的极限：不存在非平凡基于transcript的BFM能阻止两个验证者的有利可图合谋；也不存在同时满足用户、验证者及单验证者-单用户联盟激励相容的非平凡BFM。可行性方面给出对每个用户和验证者均激励相容的贪婪路由明价机制；价格更新规则的流体近似具有唯一固定点，且在足够小步长下局部稳定，大市场中价格以高概率保持在附近。

Conclusion: 带宽定价存在根本性的激励相容限制，但可通过贪婪路由明价机制实现个体层面激励相容；跨区块定价可采用EIP-1559式规则，其固定点在流体近似下局部稳定，并在大市场中具备高概率稳定性。

Abstract: We study bandwidth fee mechanisms (BFMs) for pricing threshold-certified transaction dissemination before consensus. Analogous to transaction fee mechanisms for computation, BFMs price blockchain communication, which is especially relevant when dissemination is separated from consensus and execution. We model BFMs as two-sided procurement auctions between users submitting transactions and validators receiving and forwarding them. Any validator may serve as a transaction's source and forward it to a threshold of attesters. The model accounts for receipt from the user and subsequent transfers between validators, while abstracting away unrestricted multi-hop gossip and network topology.
  We establish limits on myopic incentive compatibility: no nontrivial transcript-based BFM prevents profitable collusion between two validators, and no nontrivial BFM simultaneously satisfies incentive compatibility for individual users, individual validators, and coalitions of one validator and one user. On the feasibility side, we give a greedy-route posted-price mechanism that is incentive compatible for every individual user and validator.
  We also study bandwidth pricing across blocks. Assuming honest validator execution, we propose an EIP-1559-style price-update rule whose fluid approximation has a unique fixed point that is locally stable for sufficiently small step sizes. In large markets, prices starting near this point remain nearby with high probability over any fixed time horizon.

</details>


### [290] [Outer Diversity of Condorcet Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00720)
*Piotr Faliszewski,Jan Jabrocki,Mateusz Słuszniak,Krzysztof Sornat,Stanisław Szufa,Tomasz Wąs*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究Condorcet域的"外部多样性"，即随机投票到域中最近投票的期望交换距离。作者对少量候选人的极大Condorcet域进行数值分析，并从理论上推导了几个特殊域的渐近行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Condorcet域要求域内任意奇数票选举都产生可传递的多数关系。但域本身的性质（尤其是其覆盖投票空间的"多样性"）如何，尚需量化研究。作者引入并研究"外部多样性"这一度量，以刻画域偏离随机投票的期望程度。

Method: 将外部多样性定义为随机投票到域中最近投票的期望交换距离（Kendall tau型距离）。对候选人数较少的极大Condorcet域进行数值计算分析；针对若干特殊域（如单峰域等）采用理论推导，分析其渐近行为。

Result: 数值上给出了少量候选人下极大Condorcet域的外部多样性；理论上获得了若干特殊域外部多样性的渐近表达式，主要结论为理论性结果。

Conclusion: 外部多样性为衡量Condorcet域覆盖投票空间的能力提供了新工具；不同特殊域的渐近行为存在差异，可用于比较与设计Condorcet域。

Abstract: A Condorcet domain is a set of rankings over a given candidate set, such that every election that consists only of (an odd number of) votes from the domain has a transitive majority relation. We study outer diversity of Condorcet domains, i.e., a measure that quantifies expected swap distance from a random vote to a closest one in the domain. We numerically analyze outer diversity for maximal Condorcet domains with few candidates, and then we establish its asymptotic behavior for several special domains, mostly obtaining theoretical results.

</details>


### [291] [Fairness and Non-wastefulness in Matching with Siblings and Initial Enrollments: Compatibility and Complexity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01041)
*Haris Aziz,Gergely Csáji,Zhaohong Sun,Makoto Yokoo*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究家庭与托儿所之间的双边匹配问题：一个家庭可有多个孩子且具有联合偏好，部分孩子已在托儿所并寻求转学。模型推广了"带情侣匹配"与"含初始入学的择校"两大框架，分析公平性与非浪费性之间的权衡及计算复杂性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 家庭联合偏好与初始入学的交互，使得理想匹配（稳定匹配）不一定存在，因此需要将稳定性分解为个体理性、公平性和非浪费性，并研究它们之间的权衡。

Method: 从两个互补方向研究：(1) 为保持非浪费性，先考察基于主列表（master-list）的方法并证明其在有初始入学时不足，进而提出"重新安置"（resettlement）机制——允许被挤出的家庭回到原分配，并设计贪心改进算法；(2) 为保持公平性，先考察广义截断（cutoff）方法，再设计保持公平的非浪费算法，保证公平性加一种弱化的非浪费性。

Result: 证明主列表方法在初始入学下不充分；重新安置机制可保证"非浪费性+基于重新安置的公平性"的存在性；公平保持算法可保证公平性加弱化非浪费性。复杂性方面：若干公平概念可在多项式时间内验证，但判定是否存在满足它们的非浪费匹配是NP完全的；重新安置恢复了普遍存在性，但计算其结果PLS-难，验证更强的基于占优的公平概念是coNP完全的。

Conclusion: 引入重新安置机制能够恢复理想结果的普遍存在性，但代价是计算复杂性上升（PLS-难、coNP完全），说明公平性与非浪费性、存在性与可计算性之间存在本质权衡。

Abstract: We study a two-sided matching problem between families and daycare centers in which a family may have multiple children with joint preferences, and some children may already be enrolled in daycare centers while seeking transfers. Our model combines and generalizes two well-studied matching frameworks: matching with couples and school choice with initial enrollments. The interaction between joint family preferences and initial enrollments creates fundamental challenges for the existence of desirable outcomes and the design of computationally efficient algorithms. Since stable matchings need not exist, we decompose stability into individual rationality, fairness, and non-wastefulness, and study the trade-off between fairness and non-wastefulness from two complementary directions. To preserve non-wastefulness, we first consider master-list-based approaches and show that they are insufficient in the presence of initial enrollments. We then introduce \emph{resettlement}, which protects displaced families by allowing them to return to their initial assignments, and develop a greedy improvement algorithm that establishes the existence of matchings satisfying non-wastefulness together with resettlement-based fairness. To preserve fairness, we first examine a generalized cutoff approach and then develop a fairness-preserving non-wasteful algorithm that guarantees fairness together with a relaxed notion of non-wastefulness. We further characterize the computational complexity of these solution concepts. While several fairness notions can be verified in polynomial time, deciding whether a non-wasteful matching satisfying them exists is NP-complete. Resettlement restores universal existence, but computing resettlement-based outcomes is PLS-hard, and verifying the stronger dominance-based fairness notion is coNP-complete.

</details>


### [292] [STAKE: Preventing a colluding majority from double spending](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01169)
*Zahra Naderi,Vincent Gramoli*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 该论文提出STAKE协议，在仅需⌊n/3⌋+1诚实节点的条件下实现安全的区块链共识，通过质押机制使双重支付攻击概率多项式下降，并达到(k,t)-鲁棒均衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统区块链在开放网络中难以控制消息延迟，且经典拜占庭容错模型需要⌊2n/3⌋+1个诚实节点。已有工作通过博弈论模型引入理性玩家将诚实节点需求降至多数，但仍无法进一步降低。

Method: 提出STAKE协议，要求每个共识参与者质押与其流动性ℓ相比足够大的金额s。在博弈论模型中结合k个理性玩家和t个拜占庭玩家，通过质押激励设计使理性玩家不与拜占庭玩家合谋。

Result: 仅需⌊n/3⌋+1个诚实玩家。联盟成功执行ζ次双重支付攻击（ζ-uple attack）的概率随ζ多项式快速下降，即使s/ℓ比率相对较低也能达成(k,t)-鲁棒均衡。

Conclusion: STAKE通过质押机制将诚实节点需求降至⌊n/3⌋+1，显著低于传统拜占庭容错的⌊2n/3⌋+1，并证明理性玩家不会与拜占庭玩家合谋，为降低区块链共识的诚实节点门槛提供了新思路。

Abstract: Blockchains typically operate in open networks where it is hard to control the delay of messages. While classic blockchain protocols assumed synchrony, newer protocols try to remain secure despite unexpected network delays. Unfortunately, in the traditional model where $n$ participants can either be honest or Byzantine, we need a supermajority, or $\lfloor 2n/3\rfloor + 1$, of them to be honest. Recent work have explored the question of reducing the number of needed honest nodes in a game theory model to a majority sometimes by introducing $k$ rational players and $t$ Byzantine players. Yet, to our knowledge, no blockchain protocol managed to reduce it further.
  In this paper, we offer a blockchain protocol called Secure and Tolerant Algorithm through ($k,t$)-robust Equilibrium (STAKE) that works with only $\lfloor n/3\rfloor + 1$ honest players. STAKE requires each consensus participant to stake a sufficiently large amount $s$ compared to their liquidity $\ell$. We show that the probability that a coalition manages to execute $ζ$ double spending attacks (we call them a $ζ$-uple attack) drops polynomially fast with $ζ$. This allows us to demonstrate that STAKE reaches a ($k,t$)-robust equilibrium, or that rational players do not collude with Byzantine, even with a relatively low $s/\ell$ ratio.

</details>


### [293] [Conditioning LLMs on Social Value Orientation improves behavioural alignment in a sequential social dilemma](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01667)
*Marco Saponara,Axel Abels,Ann Nowé,Tom Lenaerts*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究用社会价值取向(SVO)条件化大语言模型(LLM)，发现可显著提升其在蜈蚣博弈中对人类行为的模拟对齐度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益用于模拟人类决策，但输出常无法体现人类行为的异质性，需探索如何更好地复现人类在序贯社会困境中的行为。

Method: 以两种蜈蚣博弈(CG)变体的实验数据为参照，比较8个LLM的默认行为与按人类样本SVO画像条件化后的行为，并测试SVO诱导对提示和顺序效应的敏感性。

Result: 默认策略在模型间差异大且普遍偏离参照分布；SVO条件化系统性地引导策略行为，对齐度最高提升70%。更高的SVO值降低停局概率，复现了亲社会性与合作的关系。

Conclusion: SVO对行为模拟的有效性不依赖LLM是否拥有稳定的社会偏好，而在于其能否将社会偏好映射到相应的策略选择上。

Abstract: Large language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate human decision-making, yet their outputs often under-represent human behavioural heterogeneity. We investigate whether conditioning LLMs on Social Value Orientation (SVO, a measure of how individuals value their own outcomes relative to others') can better reproduce human behaviour in a sequential social dilemma. Using experimental data from two variants of the Centipede Game (CG) as reference, we compare the default behaviour of eight LLMs with behaviour generated after conditioning them on SVO profiles drawn from the human sample. We find that the default strategies vary substantially across models, but are generally distant from the reference distributions. However, conditioning them on SVO profiles systematically steers their strategic behaviour, improving alignment with the human reference by up to 70% with respect to the default. Across models, higher induced SVO values decrease the probability of stopping the game, reproducing the relationship between prosociality and cooperation observed in human behaviour. Together with the sensitivity of LLMs' elicited SVO to prompt and order effects, these results suggest that the usefulness of SVO for behavioural simulation does not depend on LLMs possessing stable social preferences, but rather on their ability to map social preferences onto corresponding strategic choices.

</details>


### [294] [RANDAO Manipulation in the Presence of MEV](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02143)
*Kaya Alpturer,Nicholas Hope,S. Matthew Weinberg*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文提出广义奖励模型与计算方法，用于分析以太坊RANDAO操纵的激励，发现奖励结构（滚存、超线性）会放大操纵动机，而tail-slot罚没可恢复诚实均衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作[AW24]仅以可提议区块比例为代理衡量RANDAO操纵收益，但该比例并不能准确反映参与者真实奖励，需要更通用的奖励模型来刻画多种奖励形式与组合。

Method: 提出一个广义奖励模型，涵盖共识奖励滚存、多区块MEV、CEX-DEX套利、预言机操纵等典型奖励形式；设计一种计算方法，对任意奖励方案给出ε-最优策略；并将其应用于若干典型实例以分析敏感性。

Result: 当奖励部分滚存或随连续区块超线性增长时，RANDAO操纵的激励被放大；将tail-slot罚没建模为奖励函数后，可恢复诚实均衡。

Conclusion: RANDAO操纵动机高度依赖底层奖励结构，通过合理设计奖励函数（如tail-slot罚没）可抑制操纵、恢复诚实均衡。

Abstract: Ethereum's randomness beacon (RANDAO) is well-known to be manipulable, and prior work [AW24] computes the precise fraction of blocks a strategic proposer can propose. The fraction of blocks proposed, however, is only a proxy for participants' rewards. We propose a generalized reward model capturing many canonical forms of rewards: consensus reward rollover, multi-block MEV, CEX-DEX arbitrage, oracle manipulation, and others. We provide a methodology that computes an ε-optimal strategy for any reward scheme in our model (and in particular, any combination of the above rewards). Finally, we apply our methodology to several canonical examples, and establish the sensitivity of RANDAO manipulation to the underlying rewards. We find that if rewards partially roll over, or scale super-linearly with consecutive blocks, the incentive to manipulate RANDAO is amplified. Lastly, we investigate tail-slot slashing, which can be modeled as a reward function, and show that honest equilibria can be recovered.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [295] [Heavy-Tailed Memory Traces in Long-Horizon Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00010)
*Xinyuan Song,Zekun Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文研究长程语言智能体记忆使用的“形状”，发现记忆检索呈重尾分布（核心-长尾），并提出基于秩的核心-长尾世界模型（CTWM）控制器，通过单一指数τ分配提示预算并保留总结后的尾部，在多个基准上实现token节省与尾部预测误差降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆系统仅以任务成功率或token成本为评价标准，忽略了记忆使用的分布形状。在有限上下文与反复检索下，记忆集中于小核心而稀有状态形成长尾，导致预测误差在长尾累积。

Method: 首先进行保守的尾部审计，发现记忆集中现象可复现但依赖策略：随机游走智能体产生对数正态兼容的检索痕迹，语义LLM策略产生截断幂律兼容的核心-长尾痕迹。基于此提出CTWM——一种基于秩的记忆控制器，用单一指数τ分配提示预算，同时保留总结后的尾部。

Result: 在Synthetic Graph World上，CTWM相比图记忆基线保持完整状态与转移覆盖，提示token减少5.9%，下半尾部预测误差降低13.6%；在ALFWorld上取得一致的token节省；在LongMemEval上token减少24.48%且总体准确率持平。

Conclusion: 重尾记忆痕迹不仅是有限检索的诊断指标，也可作为token高效智能体世界模型的实用控制信号。

Abstract: Long-horizon language agents increasingly rely on external memory as a frozen world model, yet current memory systems are usually judged only by task success or token cost. We argue that the missing object is the shape of memory use: under finite context and repeated retrieval, agent memory can concentrate on a small core while leaving rare states in a long tail where prediction errors accumulate. We study this effect through a conservative tail audit and find that concentration is reproducible but policy-dependent. Random-walk agents produce log-normal-compatible retrieval artifacts, whereas semantic LLM policies yield the strongest truncated-power-law-compatible core--tail traces. Motivated by this audit, we propose Core--Tail World Model (CTWM), a rank-based memory controller that allocates prompt budget with a single exponent $τ$ while retaining a summarized tail. On Synthetic Graph World, CTWM preserves full state and transition coverage, reduces prompt tokens by 5.9%, and lowers bottom-half tail prediction error by 13.6% relative to a graph-memory baseline. The same paired comparison gives consistent token savings on ALFWorld and a 24.48% token reduction on LongMemEval with aggregate accuracy parity. These results suggest that heavy-tailed memory traces are not only a diagnostic of finite retrieval, but also a practical control signal for token-efficient agent world models.

</details>


### [296] [Frozen Scenes, Shifting Winners: Configuration Fragility in Text-to-3D Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00447)
*Anson Y. Lam,Shuqing Li,Michael R. Lyu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文审计了文本到3D渲染图像评测中协议依赖性问题：在300个固定场景、六个生成器、八种渲染/描述因素下，多数对齐评测器的配置方差超过生成器间方差，排序虽较分数稳定但仍会因配置改变而换赢家。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本到3D排行榜本应反映生成器能力，但渲染图像评测中相机设置和描述措辞成为测量协议的一部分，可能影响结果。作者希望审计：当生成场景固定时，排行榜是否仍会因评测协议变化而改变。

Method: 使用六个生成器的300个冻结场景，变化八种渲染和描述因素，涉及19个对齐评测器及一个感知质量对照，并测试四种定向场景退化。通过比较配置间方差与生成器间方差、prompt-bootstrap下界、排序赢家变化、成对协议边际包络及同时推断来分析稳定性。

Result: 17/19对齐评测器的峰值配置方差超过生成器间方差，11/19的prompt-bootstrap下界大于1；18/19评测器在某配置下改变点估计赢家。成对比较中部分出现相反点区间，但在全搜索同时推断下无反转存活。无评测器在布局打乱上超过67%的tie-adjusted方向判别率。

Conclusion: 配置导致的赢家变化是描述性的，并未确认生成器优越性变化。作者区分分数稳定性、决策不确定性和定向敏感性，建议报告(generator, score, card ID)，并采用协议依赖比较与选择感知不确定性。

Abstract: Can a text-to-3D leaderboard change when every generated scene stays fixed? We audit this question for rendered-image evaluation, where camera settings and caption wording become part of the measurement protocol. Across 300 frozen scenes from six generators, we vary eight render and caption factors for 19 alignment evaluators plus one perceptual-quality control, then test four targeted scene degradations. Peak configuration variance exceeds between-generator variance for 17/19 alignment evaluators, with prompt-bootstrap lower bounds above 1 for 11/19. Rankings are more stable than scores, yet 18/19 evaluators change their point-estimate winner under some configuration. Pairwise protocol margin envelopes show which comparisons keep their direction across the tested settings. Selected pairs have opposite pointwise intervals, but no reversal survives simultaneous inference over the full search. Thus the observed winner changes are descriptive, not confirmed changes in generator superiority. Sensitivity remains separate: no evaluator, even the prompt-free control, exceeds 67% tie-adjusted directional discrimination on layout scrambling, which is diagnostic rather than human-validated ground truth. The audit separates score stability, decision uncertainty, and targeted sensitivity, and recommends reporting (generator, score, card ID) with protocol-dependent comparisons and selection-aware uncertainty.

</details>


### [297] [When Do Causal World Models Help Modular LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00012)
*Xinyuan Song,Zekun Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究模块化LLM代理中的因果世界模型问题，提出FedCausalCompose框架，论证观测式世界模型在存在未阻断后门路径时会产生不可消除的干预误差，因果结构在跨模块接口可统计识别且以可用形式呈现时才有帮助。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM代理越来越多地通过模块化系统（订单、支付、库存、物流）行动，一个模块中的动作会改变另一模块中哪些状态转移有效。标准世界模型通常拟合观测轨迹，但这不是干预时规划所需的量：观测轨迹可能显示支付先于发货，却无法判断支付是否授权发货、库存是否中介了该效应，或是否存在隐藏触发因素。因此需要研究从观测到干预响应的因果建模缺口。

Method: 提出FedCausalCompose，一个面向模块化LLM代理的因果世界模型框架，其中局部动作提供跨模块接口的干预-响应证据。通过理论分析（干预误差下界、接口恢复随干预-响应覆盖度的改进、oracle因果组合与 非因果下界的对比）并在诊断性代理设置中验证预测。

Result: 理论上证明观测世界模型在未阻断后门路径下存在不可消除的干预误差；接口恢复随干预-响应覆盖度提升；控制覆盖度和局部机制误差时oracle因果组合可优于非因果下界。实验上，因果接口在结构化工具环境中最有效（API签名暴露前置条件和下游效应）；对话和叙事环境常忽略原始边列表，除非用简短注意力锚点使因果信息与决策相关。

Conclusion: 因果世界模型在LLM代理中发挥作用的具体条件是：跨模块接口既统计上可识别，又以代理在动作时可采用的形式呈现。这为设计模块化LLM代理的因果世界模型提供了明确指导。

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly act through modular systems, such as order, payment, inventory, and shipment services, where actions in one module change which transitions are valid in another. Standard world models usually fit observational traces, but this is not the quantity needed for intervention-time planning: a trace may show that payment precedes shipment without identifying whether payment authorizes shipment, inventory mediates the effect, or a hidden trigger explains both. We study this gap through FedCausalCompose, a causal world-model framework for modular LLM agents in which local actions provide intervention-response evidence for cross-module interfaces. We first show that observational world models incur an irreducible interventional error under unblocked back-door paths, that interface recovery improves with intervention-response coverage, and that an oracle causal composition can beat the non-causal lower bound when coverage and local mechanism errors are controlled. We then test the resulting prediction in diagnostic agent settings. Causal interfaces help most in structured tool environments, where API signatures expose preconditions and downstream effects. In contrast, dialogue and narrative environments often ignore raw edge lists unless a short attention anchor makes the causal information decision-relevant. These results identify a concrete condition for causal world models in LLM agents: causal structure helps when cross-module interfaces are both statistically identifiable and presented in a form the agent can use at action time.

</details>


### [298] [From Proposal to Verified Effect: Praxa, an Evidence-Bound Harness for Governed AI Agent Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00015)
*Stefan G. Creadore*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Praxa是一个显式区分"提议-授权-派发-验证外部效果-上线"状态的智能体执行框架，通过四类证据展示其"证据绑定架构"的贡献，但当前证据尚不足以证明其安全性与优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型智能体的"提议、授权、派发、已验证的外部效果、上线"是本质不同的声明，通常被混淆；作者希望用确定性准入、中介执行、外部回读等机制，使"授权到效果"的转换变得显式且可测试。

Method: 提出Praxa智能体harness，通过确定性准入、代理执行、外部回读、对账与审查式上线来表示状态；并报告四条证据链（仓库本地审计、Terminal-Bench试点、协调代理开发对比、部署配置证据）。

Result: 1) 固定版本审计通过1027/1027单元测试与89/89 Workerd测试，但原始逐测记录与独立复现不可得；2) Terminal-Bench试点中基线与可靠性层各通过17/36，可靠性层多用37.49%输入、50.73%输出token，不支持优越性；3) 协调代理对比中双方均180/180完成，候选方案省37.11%token、33.84%成本、11.63%步数，但不证明质量/时延/生产行为更优；4) 部署证据显示有界反射、记忆编译等路径，但无生产效果提升。

Conclusion: Praxa的贡献是"证据绑定架构"，使授权到效果的转换显式且可测试；现有证据尚不能证明对抗安全性、生产安全、通用专精优越性、自主递归优化或用户收益。

Abstract: Large-language-model agents can propose and execute actions, but proposal, authority, dispatch, verified external effect, and serving promotion are different claims. We present Praxa, an agent harness that represents these states explicitly through deterministic admission, brokered execution, external read-back, reconciliation, and reviewed promotion. We report four evidence lanes. First, an author-run repository-local audit at a pinned revision passed 1,027/1,027 unit tests and 89/89 Workerd tests, instrumented all 363 expected source files, and met four coverage floors; raw per-test transcripts and independent reproduction are unavailable. Second, in a provider-backed Terminal-Bench Core 0.1.1 pilot across 12 curated tasks, baseline and reliability-layer arms each passed 17/36 strict trials. The reliability layer used 37.49% more input and 50.73% more output tokens, so the pilot does not support superiority. Third, in a post-debug, two-order coordination-proxy development comparison, baseline and a source-authored candidate each completed 180/180 trials with equal measured accuracy, full hermetic crash recovery, and zero protected violations. The candidate used 37.11% fewer tokens, 33.84% lower estimated endpoint cost, and 11.63% fewer steps; this does not establish improved quality, latency, or production behavior. Fourth, deployed source/configuration evidence shows bounded reflection, recall accounting, memory compilation, and tool-health paths, but no production outcome lift. Praxa's supported contribution is an evidence-bound architecture that makes authority-to-effect transitions explicit and testable. Current evidence does not establish adversarial security, production safety, general specialist superiority, autonomous recursive optimization, or user benefit.

</details>


### [299] [What Do Rationales Communicate? A Message-Intervention Study in Role-Specialized QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00018)
*Jiameng Zhang,Hongqiu Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出"消息干预"诊断方法，固定证据与候选答案、只改变reasoner传递给verifier的rationale，研究其真正作用。结果显示忠实rationale几乎不提升答案准确率，而损坏的rationale会显著改变验证者的支持判断，且这种影响可被提示放大，人类审计也证实模型存在"错误信任损坏rationale"的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在角色分工的QA流水线中，reasoner会向verifier传递rationale，但这一消息通道究竟带来更好答案、更强支持评估，还是引入了新的失败面，尚不清楚。论文旨在澄清rationale共享的真实价值与风险。

Method: 提出message-intervention诊断：固定证据和候选答案，仅变化跨reasoner-to-verifier边界的rationale。在MuSiQue、HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA共400例上，以DeepSeek作为生成器和验证器；并对比盲验证提示与显式rationale检查提示，进行跨模型、任务边界检查与人类审计。

Result: 忠实rationale相比无rationale几乎不提升答案准确率；损坏rationale显著改变支持判断。盲提示下无害改写仅使支持度变化0-2.5%，损坏rationale变化10-22%；显式检查提示放大至34-55%。最终答案变化较小（2-30%），仅2.9-35.3%的损坏支持翻转伴随答案变化。人类审计中，42个有效损坏有16个为"错误信任"案例；10个模型接受的损坏rationale中，人类拒绝或标记不明确的有9个。

Conclusion: rationale共享应作为"验证消息机制"来评估，而非仅视为提升答案准确率的途径；该通道可能活跃、被放大、无效或被折叠进任务标签，存在明显失败面。

Abstract: Role-specialized QA pipelines increasingly pass rationales from a reasoner to a verifier, but it is unclear what this message actually buys: better answers, stronger support assessment, or a new failure surface. We introduce a message-intervention diagnostic that fixes the evidence and candidate answer while varying only the rationale passed across the reasoner-to-verifier boundary. On 400 MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and 2WikiMultiHopQA examples with DeepSeek as generator and verifier, faithful rationales add almost no answer accuracy over no rationale, while corrupted rationales strongly alter support judgments. Under a blind verifier prompt, harmless paraphrases shift support by only 0--2.5%, whereas corrupted rationales shift support by 10--22%; an explicit rationale-checking prompt amplifies the same pattern to 34--55%. Final answers move less (2--30%), and only 2.9--35.3% of corrupted support flips co-occur with answer changes. Human audits show why this matters: 16/42 valid corruptions are corruption-overtrust cases, and blind humans reject or mark unclear 9/10 audited corrupted rationales that the model accepts. Cross-model and task-boundary checks show when the channel is active, amplified, inert, or folded into the task label. Rationale sharing should be evaluated as a verification-message mechanism, not merely as a route to higher answer accuracy.

</details>


### [300] [Measuring the Microtask Eligibility Gap: When Is an Off-the-Shelf SLM Enough for an Agent Harness?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00025)
*Jundong Hu,Shekar Ramachandran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文构建4个微任务基准，检验现成SLM是否能达从业者阈值，发现存在"资格缺口"：16个配置无一达标，缺口主要跟踪模型规模而非量化精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent系统希望用SLM处理LLM规划器周边的微任务（自动批准shell命令、写记忆、选工具、排序历史轮次），但需验证现成SLM是否满足从业者设定的阈值，以及失败原因和量化影响。

Method: 构建含4个微任务的基准（固定prompt与自动指标），每个任务设预指定阈值τ（锚定廉价非LLM基线）及CI感知资格规则；扫描Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B（FP16、贪心、单固定prompt、无调优）；用logprob决策阈值诊断区分能力缺陷与解码阈值问题；测试4-bit量化（RTN/GPTQ/AWQ）。

Result: 16个配置（4任务×4模型）全部未通过资格；量化损坏程度依赖模型规模，且未使任何配置达标；缺口在Llama-3.x上复现（12/12不合格），对锚点选择和prompt措辞（0/112）稳健。4B重排器在BM25短名单上优于BM25（+0.047），但自身未certify资格。

Conclusion: SLM应放在满足CI阈值的基线之后，仅在基线未达标处使用SLM；资格缺口更多由模型规模而非精度决定。

Abstract: Agent harnesses increasingly want to run small language models (SLMs) on the microtasks around a frontier large language model (LLM) planner: auto-approving shell commands, writing memory, selecting tools, ranking past turns. We ask whether off-the-shelf SLMs meet practitioner-defined thresholds and, when they fail, why, and whether quantization changes the answer. We build a benchmark of 4 such microtasks with fixed prompts and automatic metrics, each with a pre-specified threshold $τ$ anchored to a cheap non-LLM baseline and a CI-aware eligibility rule (a configuration passes only if its confidence bound clears $τ$). Sweeping Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B at their best (FP16, greedy, one frozen prompt, no tuning), we find an eligibility gap: 0 of 16 (4 tasks $\times$ 4 models) configurations pass (verified by checking the raw outputs and parser behavior). A logprob decision-threshold diagnostic (T1/T3/T4; T2 via a context-length/cascade probe) separates the failures into capability deficits and failures that can be addressed by changing the decoding threshold (4 regimes). Quantization to 4-bit (RTN/GPTQ/AWQ) does damage that depends on model size and moves no configuration into eligibility (certified on the reconstructable hard-label tasks T1/T3, diagnostic/windowed robustness on T2/T4), so the gap tracks model size more than precision; it replicates on Llama-3.x (12/12 ineligible) and is robust to the anchor choice (a $τ$-sweep) and to prompt wording (0/112 eligible across the original plus 3 neutral paraphrases per cell). The practical implication: place SLMs behind a baseline that meets the CI-backed threshold, and use the SLM only where the baseline fails to meet the threshold; e.g. a 4B re-ranker over a BM25 shortlist beats BM25 ($+0.047$ [0.020, 0.073], without itself certifying eligibility).

</details>


### [301] [Characterizing a Configuration Where Inference-Time PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting Is Inert: Evidence from Three Reasoning LMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00047)
*Khawaja Murad ul Hassan,Mehran Ebrahimi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文严格检验PRM剪枝片段嫁接（PPFG）机制：在高PRM前缀被移植到并行解码链时，其效果与独立并行CoT基线统计上无差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并行链式思维存在多样性崩溃，现有推理时干预通过将高PRM前缀嫁接进其他解码链来补救，但该机制本身是否有效尚未被单独、严格地隔离检验。

Method: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct + Math-Shepherd、MATH500（n=500，三种子）上隔离PPFG，设停滞与随机两种目标变体；对322次注入事件做四桶分类，做消融与随机对照，跨3个基座LM、6个基准、第二个PRM及兼容门扫描复现，并用双单侧检验（TOST）分析等价性。

Result: PPFG各变体在所有测量轴上与独立并行CoT基线统计无差异；仅14%注入命中真正挣扎的链，多数落在已成功、近完成或PRM平台状态；随机制约同样无效；TOST在全部12个Qwen/LLaMA单元上确认正等价；事后oracle显示任意单题增益上限仅+0.13pp。

Conclusion: PPFG在其测试操作点上对并行CoT无实质增益，惰性非启发式特有；论文贡献了建立推理时机制零结果的等价性检验模板，所有结论限定于所测操作点。

Abstract: Diversity collapse in parallel chain-of-thought has motivated inference-time interventions built on a natural design: when a process reward model (PRM) prunes a chain, its high-PRM prefix is extracted and grafted verbatim as an in-context demonstration into a still-decoding sibling. We isolate this mechanism, PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting (PPFG), as the most cost-minimal operationalization of cross-trajectory step-level transfer, and test it at the operating point where prior fragment-grafting work reports gains only under additional compensating ingredients. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with Math-Shepherd on full MATH500 (n=500, three seeds), PPFG in both stagnation- and random-targeting variants is statistically indistinguishable from an independent parallel-CoT baseline on every measured axis. We characterize why: a four-bucket classification of 322 stagnation-rule injection events shows only 14% targeted a genuinely struggling chain; the rest landed on chains that had already succeeded, were near completion, or sat on a flat PRM plateau, states a rescue graft cannot change. No compound-gate refinement jointly achieves well-targeted firing and adequate density, and a random control matches the same parity at 2.4x the firing rate, so the inertness is not heuristic-specific. The finding replicates across three base LMs, six benchmarks, a second PRM, and a compatibility-gate sweep; two-one-sided-tests analysis promotes the parity to positive equivalence on all twelve Qwen/LLaMA cells. A per-event spot-check finds injected chains prune at 2.75x the matched-step rate, but a surviving-sibling counterfactual finds no population-level compensation. A hindsight oracle bounds any per-problem gain from choosing PPFG over independent at +0.13 pp. We contribute an equivalence-testing template for establishing inference-time mechanism nulls, with every claim scoped to its tested operating point.

</details>


### [302] [Robust Is Salient: An Informed Adversary Moves the Optimal Signal onto the Salience Pole](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00233)
*Cris Huynh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文研究受限信号通道中对抗性听众下的最优信号选择，发现鲁棒最优恰与既有"显著性(salience)"极点重合，仅在少量坐标未定义项目上不同，并指出这构成对抗意识评估的结构性限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当信息发送者面对会共同收听信号并辩论出最强错误答案的"知情对手"时，最优信号如何选择？该对抗设定可能改变信号的优化目标（从贝叶斯后验最大化转向边界最大化），进而影响以往仅用后验衡量的评估，因此需要形式化分析对抗鲁棒最优与既有显著性启发式的区别。

Method: 在抽象自桌游《Deception: Murder in Hong Kong》的强制选择任务中引入对手：对手知道目标、观察信号、以说服预算β辩论出最强错误答案。分析最优信号随β的变化；在108个确证项目与20万项目池上比较对抗鲁棒最优与既有显著性极点；对七个语言模型施加两种对手框架进行实证。

Result: 随β增大，最优信号从后验最大化选项转向边界最大化选项；β=0时还原原oracle模型(τ=1)。在108个确证项目上，对抗鲁棒最优与显著性极点完全一致；在20万项目池中仅2,748项不同，且差异恰位于显著性-贝叶斯坐标未定义处。池中18.2%项目的最优在有限预算下发生转移，每项目临界预算可精确求解。两种对手框架使七个语言模型在108项中有30–77项改变选项。但由于这些项目上鲁棒最优与显著性选项相同，无法判断模型的移动是朝向对抗意识最优还是显著性。

Conclusion: 对抗鲁棒最优与显著性启发式在结构上高度重合，这限制了对抗意识的实证评估：模型行为的移动无法区分是朝向鲁棒最优还是启发式。该限制是结构性的而非零结果；建议在评估对抗意识前，先检查鲁棒目标是否与启发式目标在评估项目上重合。

Abstract: When an informed adversary shares the audience of a constrained signalling channel, the signal that best protects the truth is the signal that best describes it. On 108 confirmatory items, the adversary-robust optimum aligns exactly with the salience pole from prior work. Across a 200,000-item pool, the two differ on only 2,748 items --- lying exactly where the prior salience-to-Bayes coordinate is undefined. Where defined, robustness is achieved by moving from Bayesian discrimination entirely to salience. We show this by introducing an adversary to a forced-choice task (abstracted from Deception: Murder in Hong Kong). The adversary knows the target, observes the signal, and argues for the strongest wrong answer using a persuasion budget, $β$. As $β$ grows, the optimal signal shifts from the posterior-maximizing option to the margin-maximizing one; at $β= 0$, the game reproduces the original oracle model with a listener temperature of $τ= 1$. This effect is real: 18.2 percent of the pool has an optimum that shifts under a finite budget, and each item's critical budget is exact. This coincidence structurally limits empirical evaluation. Two adversary framings change the chosen option of seven language models on 30 to 77 of 108 items against an exact no-effect rate. Yet, no measurement can determine whether this movement is toward the adversary-aware optimum or toward salience, because the two options are identical. This is a structural limit, not a null result. The diagnostic check is cheap: before evaluating adversary-awareness, verify whether the robust target coincides with a heuristic target on the evaluation items.

</details>


### [303] [Gradient-Aligned Pair Selection for Personalized Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00061)
*Ruoming Jin,Xinyu Li,Hao Zhou,Jianfeng Zhu,Ruixin Guo,Feodor Dragan,Lei Xu,Haixun Wang,Yang Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出GAP-DPO，通过分析用户效用梯度与DPO更新方向的几何对齐关系，将个性化偏好学习的配对选择建模为几何优化问题，实验证明其优于标准DPO变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DPO在个性化场景中的效果取决于偏好对的选取方式，而现有方法多用启发式准则（如基于似然的极端值），将优化目标与显式用户效用解耦，导致个性化效果下降。

Method: 将个性化偏好学习形式化为几何对齐的优化问题，分析期望用户效用梯度与DPO更新方向的一阶交互；发现当偏好间隔与效用梯度方向对齐时，DPO更新由纠错信号转变为类强化学习更新。据此提出GAP-DPO，迭代进行效用感知、几何对齐的配对选择，并通过按轮次重生成控制分布偏移。

Result: 在个性化文本生成基准上，GAP-DPO在风格保真度、偏好对齐和生成质量方面一致优于标准DPO变体。

Conclusion: 梯度对齐可作为个性化偏好优化的统一原则，配对选择是优化几何的内在组成部分，而非启发式的预处理步骤。

Abstract: Personalizing large language models (LLMs) requires aligning generation behavior with user-specific preferences rather than aggregate quality. While Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) provides a stable framework for preference learning, its effectiveness in personalized settings critically depends on how preference pairs are selected. Existing approaches typically rely on heuristic criteria, such as likelihood-based extremes, which decouple optimization from explicit user utility and can lead to degraded personalization. We formalize personalized preference learning as a geometry-aligned optimization problem by analyzing the first-order interaction between gradients of expected user utility and DPO update directions. Our analysis reveals that, under off-policy sampling, the DPO update transitions from a purely error-corrective signal to a reinforcement-like update when preference margins are directionally aligned with utility gradients. This perspective exposes pair selection as a geometric decision that governs whether preference optimization advances or hinders personalization. Motivated by this insight, we propose GAP-DPO (Geometry-Aligned Preference DPO), an iterative algorithm that performs utility-aware, geometry-aligned pair selection while controlling distribution shift via epoch-wise regeneration. Experiments on personalized text generation benchmarks show that GAP-DPO consistently improves stylistic fidelity, preference alignment, and generation quality compared to standard DPO variants. Together, our results establish gradient alignment as a unifying principle for personalized preference optimization and demonstrate that pair selection is an intrinsic component of the optimization geometry rather than a heuristic preprocessing step.

</details>


### [304] [K-Dense BYOK: An Open-Source AI Research Assistant That Runs Locally and Keeps a Hash-Chained Lab Notebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00074)
*Aubrey M. Brueckner,Darshil Patel,Yuhuan He,Timothy Kassis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: K-Dense BYOK 是一个免费开源的本地化 AI 科研助手,研究人员自带模型密钥,应用提供运行环境、科研支撑层与完整记录。它通过本地文件夹存储项目保证数据可读性,以科学流程库、Living Lab Notebook 和独立观测日志区别于普通聊天/编码助手,尤其针对模型"过度声称"失败模式。在20个跨学科研究提示的预定义评分中,其科学质量与执行表现超过两个托管平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有聊天助手和通用编码智能体不适合科研工作:缺乏科学流程支撑、记录不可追溯、且模型常"过度声称"(overclaiming)。作者此前对九个前沿模型的基准测试显示这是最常见失败模式,因此需要一个让声称可被核查而非简单阻止的工具。

Method: K-Dense BYOK 在研究者本地运行,自带模型接入(托管或本地)。提供三层科学脚手架:书面科学流程库、引导式工作流模板、研究数据来源目录、以及审查与写作角色;维护只增不删、条目相互链接的 Living Lab Notebook;并通过监视智能体行为(而非采信其自述)记录日志,日志智能体无写入工具。以普通文件夹组织项目,数据/代码/结果/记录均可脱离应用长期读取。

Result: 在20个跨学科研究提示、预先固定评分标准下,K-Dense BYOK 在科学质量与研究执行两方面均领先两个托管平台;其交付物是唯一记录了所运行软件的,且通常附带可复现结果的命令。其中一个托管平台使用相同前沿模型却两项都不提供。环境记录虽为智能体所写文件,但尚未纳入观测日志。

Conclusion: 本地化、自带密钥的科研助手在科学质量与可复现执行上优于托管平台,关键在于科学脚手架、不可篡改记录与基于行为观测的日志。当前不足是观测日志尚未捕获软件环境本身,需未来扩展。代码以 MIT 许可开源。

Abstract: K-Dense BYOK (bring your own keys) is a free, open-source AI research assistant for scientists in any field that runs on the researcher's own computer. The researcher supplies access to a model of their choice, hosted or running locally, and the application supplies everything else: a place for the work to run, a layer of scientific scaffolding, and a complete record. Each project is an ordinary folder, so the data, the code, the results, and the record stay on a machine the researcher administers and can be read years later without the application. Three things separate it from a chat assistant or a general-purpose coding agent. It ships a library of written scientific procedures, guided workflow templates, catalogs of where research data can be found, and reviewer and writer roles the agent can hand work to. It keeps a Living Lab Notebook whose entries link into an argument and are added to but never erased. And it records what happened by watching what the agent does rather than by taking the agent's word for it, in a log the agent has no tool that can write to. That choice targets the most common failure, model overclaiming, in our earlier benchmark of nine frontier models, by making claims checkable rather than preventing them. On twenty interdisciplinary research prompts, scored under a rubric fixed in advance, K-Dense BYOK led two managed platforms on both scientific quality and research execution. Its deliverables were the only ones that recorded the software they ran in, and the only ones that usually arrived with a command that regenerates the results. One of the managed platforms ran the same frontier model and supplied neither. Those environment records were files the agent wrote, not part of the observed log, which does not yet capture the software environment itself. The code is available under the MIT license at https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/k-dense-byok.

</details>


### [305] [Scientific Agents: Evaluating Profession-Specific System Prompts on Scientific Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00084)
*Timothy Kassis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 对503个职业特定AGENTS.md配置文件的评估表明，加载完整职业提示词不会提升准确率，反而显著增加token消耗和成本，仅在API稳定性上有一个意外优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 职业特定系统提示词被广泛使用，但其是否真正提升准确性、以及所付出的token和成本代价是否值得，此前缺乏系统性验证。

Method: 构建Scientific Agents开源语料（503个职业特定AGENTS.md配置文件），用Gemini 3.8 Flash经OpenRouter在Pi agent框架上运行。设置四种对照：极简基线、职业开头句、通用科学严谨指南、无关领域配置。在9个文本科学基准（4,531题、100个匹配配置）上评测，另在60个需工具调用的BioMysteryBench生物信息学问题上各运行三次，采用自动化规则评分。

Result: 配置文件与基线平均准确率差为-0.6个百分点（95%自助区间[-1.5, +0.2]），无基准显示显著提升；输出token为基线的1.5-2.3倍，每次成功调用成本高2.2-4.5倍。BioMysteryBench解决率46.7% vs 基线56.7%（差-10.0个百分点）。意外发现：SuperGPQA上因API中断，长提示首次正确率71.6%，短基线仅54.0%，且通用/不匹配提示同样可靠，说明优势来自提示长度或格式而非领域专业性。

Conclusion: 对测试的模型和任务而言，默认加载完整职业配置文件不提升准确率且成本显著更高；是否可通过选择性检索配置片段或采用开放式科学任务改变结论，仍有待验证。

Abstract: Detailed profession-specific system prompts raise token use and estimated cost per response without a consistent accuracy gain. We evaluate Scientific Agents, an open-source corpus of 503 profession-specific AGENTS.md profiles, with Gemini 3.8 Flash via OpenRouter in the Pi agent harness. We compare matched profiles with four controls: a minimal baseline ("You are a helpful assistant"), the profile's opening role sentence, a generic scientific rigor guide, and a profile from an unrelated domain. Across nine text-based science benchmarks (4,531 sampled questions, 100 matched profiles), 4,488 items completed all five conditions after API-error retries, scored with automated, rule-based grading. The average profile-baseline accuracy difference is -0.6 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval [-1.5, +0.2] across fixed tasks), and no benchmark shows a statistically clear improvement. Matched profiles produced 1.5-2.3 times as many output tokens and cost 2.2-4.5 times more per successful call. On 60 tool-using BioMysteryBench bioinformatics problems (three runs each for baseline and profile), mean solve rates were 46.7% with the profile and 56.7% at baseline, a difference of -10.0 percentage points (95% interval [-16.7, -3.3]) driven by more frequent token- and time-limit stops under the profile. Longer prompts had one unexpected operational advantage: on SuperGPQA, frequent provider API drops left the short baseline with a correct first-pass answer on only 54.0% of items, against 71.6% with the profile. Generic and mismatched prompts were about as reliable, so this gain comes from prompt length or formatting rather than domain expertise. For the tested model and tasks, loading full profession profiles by default does not improve accuracy and costs considerably more; whether selective retrieval of profile sections or open-ended scientific tasks would change this remains to be tested.

</details>


### [306] [Comedic Fool's Gold: Reward Exploits and Countermeasures in Conversational Humor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00197)
*Sam Larson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究对话幽默训练中自动奖励的"奖励漏洞"及对策，发现惊喜奖励和观众笑声奖励均可被利用，防御措施在堵漏同时会误伤真实幽默。三次RL实验中最终版本提升综合评分0.0903、零分会话减少40%，但幽默专项提升未达预注册目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化奖励设计面临"既要堵住可利用捷径、又要保留目标行为"的根本矛盾。本文以对话幽默为切入，探究现有奖励（可理解惊喜、预测观众娱乐度）在实践中如何被exploit，以及防御措施是否有效。

Method: 采用两类奖励途径：(1) 基于embedding的惊喜奖励 + 流畅度过滤器；(2) 观众模型预测笑声 + 跨说话人线索归一化。通过受控测试检验漏洞，并进行三次递进式奖励修订的强化学习训练，进行对比评估。

Result: embedding惊喜奖励无法区分词序打乱回复与机智回复；流畅度过滤器能检测打乱，但组合奖励误拒部分机智回复并未通过进一步验证。观众模型易受任一方笑声线索影响，归一化可阻断已覆盖攻击但未被匹配的表达仍可被利用。最终RL run综合评分提升0.0903、零分会话减少40%，幽默专项提升低于预注册目标。

Conclusion: 自动奖励设计存在普遍挑战：防御措施必须阻断可利用捷径，同时保留奖励本应鼓励的行为。当前对策在堵漏与保真之间难以两全，幽默专项提升未达预期。

Abstract: We investigate automated rewards for training language models in conversational humor, focusing on reward exploits and countermeasures. Two approaches aim to capture understandable surprise and predicted audience amusement. Controlled tests show that an embedding-based surprise reward accepts word-shuffled replies as readily as witty ones. A fluency filter detects the shuffles, but the combined reward also rejects some witty replies and fails further validation. An audience model's predicted laughter is instead vulnerable to laughter cues in either speaker's messages. Normalizing these cues across speakers blocks the covered attacks, although unmatched expressions remain exploitable. Three reinforcement-learning runs evaluate training with successive reward revisions. The final run improves the combined evaluation score by 0.0903 and reduces zero-score sessions by 40%, but its humor-specific improvement remains below our preregistered target. These findings illustrate a broader challenge for automated reward design: countermeasures must block exploitable shortcuts while preserving the behavior the reward was intended to encourage.

</details>


### [307] [EviGraph: Proof-Carrying Selective Recommendation over Temporal Public-Service Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00212)
*Yixi Zhou,Sikun Wang,Lei Fan,Fan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 EviGraph 框架，区分"关键决策需求"与可保留未决的信息，用语言智能体将需求链接到时序知识图谱证据，再由确定性检查器判定推荐是否被支持；在粤语/英语香港公共服务基准上减少不必要弃答，但额外验证可能撤销已支持推荐而无益于决策质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公共服务推荐需匹配服务、范围与日期的证据，但把所有缺失细节都视为决定性会导致有价值的推荐被拒绝（过度弃答）。

Method: EviGraph：区分关键决策要求与可未决信息；语言智能体将要求链接到时序知识图谱中的证据；确定性检查器判定推荐是否有支持。

Result: 在带有可执行政策引用的双语香港公共服务基准上，该区分降低了不必要的弃答；但增加验证步骤会在不提升决策质量的情况下撤回已被支持的推荐。

Conclusion: 可靠的可循证导航取决于明确"决策必须确立什么"，而非简单叠加更多验证。

Abstract: Public-service recommendations require evidence that matches the requested service, scope, and date. Yet treating every missing detail as decisive can withhold useful recommendations. We introduce EviGraph, which distinguishes critical decision requirements from information that can remain unresolved. A language agent links these requirements to evidence in a temporal knowledge graph, while a deterministic checker establishes whether a recommendation is supported. Evaluation on a bilingual Hong Kong public-service benchmark with executable policy references shows that this distinction reduces unnecessary abstention. Additional verification, however, can withdraw supported recommendations without improving decision quality. These findings suggest that reliable evidence-based navigation depends on specifying what must be established for a decision, rather than simply adding more verification.

</details>


### [308] [Build2SPARQL: A Large-Scale Text-to-SPARQL Benchmark Dataset for Building Knowledge Graph Querying](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00224)
*Wooyoung Jung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Build2SPARQL，一个面向建筑知识图谱的大规模text-to-SPARQL基准，通过图谱驱动的流水线生成6136条可执行SPARQL查询和30680个自然语言问题，并验证其质量与检索增强评估效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建筑自动化系统日益以语义知识图谱（Brick、ASHRAE 223P）表示，支持将自然语言问题翻译为SPARQL，但该方向受限于缺乏大规模自然语言/SPARQL基准数据。

Method: 采用图谱驱动的生成流水线：SPARQL查询完全由图遍历代码生成并验证，大语言模型仅负责生成自然语言问题，从而保证查询正确性独立于模型。挖掘六类查询模式（线性链、分支、UNION、聚合、OPTIONAL、属性过滤），并以五种词汇风格对每个查询进行提问表述。应用于201个建筑知识图谱（180个Brick、21个ASHRAE 223P）。

Result: 生成6136条可执行SPARQL查询与30680个问题。对300个问题的双人人工验证显示语义保真度98.8%、自然度98.8%、可操作合理性84.0%。在三个开源权重语言模型上的检索增强评估中，精确匹配准确率从零样本的0.2–20%提升至三样本检索的56–65%。

Conclusion: Build2SPARQL为建筑知识图谱的text-to-SPARQL提供了大规模、高质量的基准，检索增强显著提升模型性能，但仍存在改进空间。

Abstract: Building automation systems are increasingly represented as semantic knowledge graphs (KGs) using ontologies such as Brick and ASHRAE 223P, creating a machine-readable substrate for artificial-intelligence applications. One promising application is translating natural-language questions into SPARQL (text-to-SPARQL), which would let building operators query these graphs through language agents, but progress is limited by the scarcity of large natural-language/SPARQL benchmarks. This paper presents Build2SPARQL, a large-scale benchmark for building KGs generated by a KG-grounded pipeline: SPARQL queries are produced and validated entirely by graph-traversal code, while large language models generate only the natural-language questions, keeping query correctness independent of model behavior. The pipeline mines six query-pattern families -- linear chains, branching, UNION, aggregation, OPTIONAL, and attribute-filtered -- and phrases each query across five vocabulary registers. Applied to 201 building KGs (180 Brick, 21 ASHRAE 223P), it yields 6,136 executable SPARQL queries and 30,680 questions. A two-rater human validation of 300 questions found 98.8% semantic fidelity, 98.8% naturalness, and 84.0% operational plausibility. A retrieval-augmented evaluation across three open-weight language models raised exact-match accuracy from 0.2-20% (zero-shot) to 56-65% (three-shot retrieved).

</details>


### [309] [Enterprise Representation Simplification (ERS): Reducing Representational Complexity for Enterprise AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00791)
*Terry Dorsey,Kevin Huggins*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出企业表征简化(ERS)与企业表征复杂度(ERC)模型,用四个维度刻画表征复杂度,并分析其生命周期成本与对AI推理的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业信息由应用、项目、技术、组织边界等形成的工件承载,随时间累积产生表征复杂度,需企业维护并被消费者和AI系统解读。本文旨在定义并量化这种不必要的表征复杂度。

Method: 提出ERS(在给定范围内减少不必要复杂度同时保留必需信息)与ERC模型。ERC从Representation Objects、Interactions、Behaviors、Supporting Sources四个维度刻画表征范围,并定义在表征与任务两个层级,以区分架构简化与检索优化。

Result: 得出两个推论:一是表征结构产生生命周期义务,经济模型区分全局表征成本、任务级成本与一次性转换成本;二是任务级ERC降低可减少AI需识别、关联和解读的表征范围,Text-to-SQL研究证明降低schema与推理复杂度可提升推理准确率。

Conclusion: ERC并非通用复杂度、性能或成本指标,而是提供可度量的架构变量,用于比较表征方案、转换效果、经济结果与AI推理性能。

Abstract: Enterprise information is represented through artifacts shaped by applications, projects, technologies, organizational boundaries, and local requirements. These structures accumulate over time, creating representational complexity that must be maintained by the enterprise and interpreted by information consumers and AI systems. This paper introduces Enterprise Representation Simplification (ERS) as reducing unnecessary representational complexity while preserving required information within a defined scope, and Enterprise Representation Complexity (ERC), a representation-neutral model for comparing complexity across representation states.
  ERC characterizes representational extent through four dimensions: Representation Objects, Interactions, Behaviors, and Supporting Sources. Objects, Interactions, and Behaviors form dependent categories, while Supporting Sources characterize representation exposure. ERC is defined at representation and task levels, enabling comparison and distinguishing architectural simplification from retrieval optimization.
  The paper develops two consequences of ERS. First, representational structures create lifecycle obligations for maintenance, governance, dependencies, change, enhancement, and operation. An economic model distinguishes recurring global representation cost, recurring task-level cost, and one-time transformation cost, enabling evaluation over a defined time horizon. Second, reductions in task-level ERC reduce the representational extent an AI system must identify, relate, and interpret. Text-to-SQL research provides evidence that reduced schema and reasoning complexity can improve reasoning accuracy.
  ERC is not a universal complexity, performance, or cost metric. It provides measurable architectural variables for comparing representational alternatives, transformation effects, economic outcomes, and AI reasoning performance.

</details>


### [310] [Conflicting Supervision Moves Commitment, Not Capability: A 12.29σ arrangement effect that is exactly zero under a convention-agnostic score](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00234)
*Wenhui Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文证明学习率调度是决定数据顺序效应的“平均算子”，将样本排列与调度分离为相乘因子，并给出两种调度下顺序效应的受控测量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练数据的顺序是否影响模型是核心问题，而过往工作忽略了学习率调度在其中的决定性作用——它并非背景条件，而是决定答案的平均算子。

Method: 在同一语料上构造十种排列、固定预算与其余条件，仅改变 lr_scheduler_type（恒定 vs 余弦），各跑两次；证明排列只以块周期进入、调度只以端点最大权重进入的相乘上界，并用控制实验分别测量两半。

Result: 恒定速率下内部跨度达 0.2221 分配、11.63 对比下限，且随阻塞程度单调；单一余弦调度下十个臂仅占两个可区分状态（分辨率本可容纳约十个）。十二个臂中 acc_A+acc_B 恒定在 9.7% 以内而分配份额从 0.04 到 0.87，说明约定无关指标下 12.29-sigma 的排列切换为零。在提示中标注约定可坍缩切换并达到并集上界的 87.5%。

Conclusion: “顺序重要”与“顺序不重要”实为同一旋钮的两端；路径写入的是模型对何种约定的承诺，任何精确匹配基准都无法察觉，只有约定感知指标才能测得该效应。

Abstract: "Train a model on the same problems written under two incompatible conventions, both correct, and ask what the ordering of that data writes into the parameters. The learning-rate schedule is not a background condition for that question. It is the averaging operator, and it decides the answer. We prove a bound in which the arrangement and the schedule enter the ordering effect as separate multiplied factors: the arrangement only as a block period, the schedule only as how much weight the endpoint can place on any one moment of the run. A decaying schedule cannot put a large step size and an uncontracted remainder at the same moment; a constant one does exactly that at the last step. That decay moderates ordering effects has been reported in pretraining; the mechanism, the separation, and a controlled measurement of both halves are ours. Ten orderings of one corpus, one budget, everything but the path held fixed, run twice under families differing in lr_scheduler_type and nothing else: at a constant rate the interior spans 0.2221 in allocation, 11.63 contrast floors, monotone in how blocked the arrangement is. Under the single cosine every published arm uses, the same ten arms occupy two distinguishable states where their own resolution would allow about ten. "Order matters" and "order does not matter" are the two ends of one knob. What the path writes is which convention the model commits to, and no exact-match benchmark can see it. Across twelve arms acc_A+acc_B is constant to within 9.7% while the allocation share runs 0.04 to 0.87, so the 12.29-sigma arrangement switch this paper measures is exactly zero under a convention-agnostic metric. That conservation is quoted from the decayed family throughout, the constant-rate one being a noisier place to read it. Marking the convention in the prompt collapses the switch and reaches 87.5% of the union ceiling."

</details>


### [311] [Knowing When to Yield: Grounded Arbitration of User Corrections in Text-Based Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00282)
*Yezhou Cheng,Runjia Du,Zeming Liu,Hang Lyu,Zehua Yang,Bojun Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出GAVA框架，让具身智能体在人类纠正可能有误时，在"接受/拒绝/检视世界/询问说话者"间仲裁；文本ALFWorld实验显示局部检视可保证100%纠正准确率，语义先验能降低交互与联合成本并得到复现，但未证明VOI普遍优于澄清。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类纠正并非总是正确，具身智能体需要判断何时采信、拒绝、自行检视环境或向说话者求证，而非盲目接受或一律核实。

Method: 将grounded correction arbitration形式化为四选一决策问题；GAVA用观测受限证据、合法探针与一步期望损失规则实现；在纯文本ALFWorld上构造972个配对的真/假干预，并测试语义对象位置先验（训练-only）。

Result: 完整局部检视使GAVA与always-verify均达100%纠正准确率（证据契约）；同episode执行降低交互成本；语义先验在340个未见场景使交互/联合成本相对uniform GAVA降0.490/0.420，冻结后77个不重叠checkpoint（308场景）复现为0.595/0.517，95%置信区间排除零；语义GAVA准确率98.8%/98.7%，所有方法完成任务；no-VOI比较无定论。

Conclusion: 结果支持在声明成本下结合选择性信息收集与语义先验，但未证明环境VOI相对澄清的普遍优势；研究限于规范化声明、完整符号观测与受控说话者，未评估真人、视觉输入或物理机器人。

Abstract: How should an embodied agent respond when a person's correction may be wrong? We formulate grounded correction arbitration as a choice among accepting, rejecting, inspecting the world, and asking the speaker. GAVA implements this interface with observation-bounded evidence, legal probes, and a one-step expected-loss rule. In text-only ALFWorld, 162 checkpoints produce 972 paired true and false interventions.
