To address these issues, we propose Robust Nash Alignment, a game-theoretic framework for alignment to uncertain pairwise preferences. Our formulation has a major learner seeking a policy with a large worst-case win rate against both an adversarial competitor and any preference kernel lying in an ambiguity set around a nominal preference. When the ambiguity set captures the uncertainty in preferences, the resulting robust objective of the game directly yields a certified lower bound on worst-case performance. However, we note this problem is computationally challenging to optimize, and to address this, we introduce a four-player primal-dual proxy game involving the leader policy, follower policy, adversarial kernel, and dual variable, and develop a single-loop optimistic mirror descent-ascent algorithm for it. We show that the proxy always lower-bounds the truncated hard-constrained objective, quantify the proxy-to-hard gap, and characterize an exactness condition under which the proxy recovers the robust objective. We then prove an \(\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})\) average-iteration convergence for the proxy-game duality gap, which implies a near-optimal robust policy for the original robust objective. Experiments on controlled tabular games and LLM alignment with uncertain preference further validate the convergence theory and show improved performance over nominal baselines.

</details>


### [347] [Sapien: A Stateful Policy Engine for Autonomous AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00797)
*Corinn Tiffany,Wen Zhang,Eugene Bagdasarian,Lillian Tsai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Sapien是一个面向AI代理的状态化上下文策略引擎，通过正则表达式扩展状态谓词、延迟策略生成和语义检查来约束工具调用，将攻击成功率降低至93-95%（AgentDojo）与62-85%（Toolathlon），同时保持接近无约束代理的效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多步任务中，合法动作依赖代理已执行与已获取的信息，传统无状态上下文防御难以准确判断合法性，因此需要状态化策略执行机制。

Method: Sapien策略使用扩展正则表达式指定允许的工具调用序列，结合状态谓词、延迟策略生成与作用域语义检查，并在代理工具调用上强制执行。

Result: 在AgentDojo上排除93-95%攻击，在Toolathlon上排除62-85%攻击（长程任务中约为工具白名单的两倍），效用与无约束代理相差仅几个百分点。

Conclusion: 状态化上下文策略能在保持效用的同时显著提升多步代理对劫持攻击的防御能力，优于简单工具白名单。

Abstract: Contextual security defenses prevent AI agents from taking rogue actions by synthesizing a task-specific policy and enforcing it on the agent's tool calls. In multi-step tasks, however, which actions are valid often depends on what the agent has already done and learned. We present Sapien, a policy engine for enforcing stateful contextual policies. A Sapien policy specifies permitted tool-call sequences using a regular expression extended with stateful predicates, deferred policy generation, and scoped semantic checks. We show that Sapien stays within a few percent of an unconstrained agent's utility. Even if the agent is fully hijacked, Sapien's policies rule out 93-95% of attacks on AgentDojo and 62-85% on Toolathlon (twice as many as tool allowlists on long-horizon tasks).

</details>


### [348] [Kepler: Auditable World Models for ARC-AGI-3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00834)
*Wensen Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Kepler是一个开源评测框架，将假设表示为可执行世界模型，通过回溯转移检查和条件预测检查进行验证；在ARC-AGI-3上以冻结配置取得25个公开游戏全部满分RHAE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ARC-AGI-3要求智能体从观察中推断交互环境的规则与目标，现有评测缺乏对假设验证机制和结果可靠性的充分刻画。

Method: 提出Kepler harness，把假设表示为可执行世界模型，用回溯式状态转移校验与条件预测校验来验证；在单一冻结的Claude Opus 5配置下评测，不做逐游戏模型选择或按分数条件重跑。

Result: 服务器验证在25个公开游戏上全部达到100.00 RHAE；183个完成关卡中181个最终尝试所用动作不多于人类中位数基线；保留棋盘使用8,256次环境动作（7,292次在计分关卡）；本地记录显示858.0M tokens、97.37%缓存读取、按2026-09-01 API价格约$777.72。另报告三类评测失败：源码泄漏导致无效满分、控制条件下智能体重建被移除的harness、自动修复掩盖规划器故障。个案显示动画帧含静态网格缺失的任务相关信息。最终Opus 5与GPT-5.6 Sol棋盘50个游戏-模型单元中48个达到100。

Conclusion: 公开集单一分数区分度有限，应倡导首次尝试、成本条件化和验证感知的评测报告方式。

Abstract: ARC-AGI-3 evaluates agents in interactive environments whose rules and objectives must be inferred from observation. We present Kepler, an open-source harness that represents hypotheses as executable world models and validates them through retrospective transition checks and conditional prediction checks. Under one frozen Claude Opus 5 configuration, Kepler obtained a server-verified 100.00 RHAE on all 25 public games, with no per-game model selection or score-conditioned reruns. On 181 of 183 completed levels, the final Opus attempt used no more actions than the corresponding median-human baseline. The retained board runs used 8,256 environment actions, of which 7,292 occurred in scored levels. Retained local provider-session records yield 858.0 million tokens, 97.37% cache reads, and a \$777.72 cost at September 1, 2026 API list-equivalent rates. We also report three evaluation failures: source-code leakage that produced an invalid perfect run, agents reconstructing a removed harness in a control condition, and autonomous repair masking a broken planner. A single-game observation case study showed that animation frames contained task-relevant information absent from settled text grids. Across the final Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol boards, 48 of 50 game-model cells reached 100. These results indicate that public-set score alone has limited discriminative value and motivate first-attempt, cost-conditioned, and verification-aware reporting.

</details>


### [349] [Learning Multiple Timescales for Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00849)
*Pedro Robles Dutenhefner,Dikshant Shehmar,Wagner Meira,Marlos C. Machado*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出GITA，将值函数以k为条件，通过聚合多个k值下的优势加权监督训练单一策略，同时保留局部分辨率与长程信号，在OGBench上大幅超越离线GCRL基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线目标条件强化学习（GCRL）难以处理长时程任务：折扣会使远距离状态的价值差异缩小到函数逼近误差以下，导致缺乏状态排序信号。时间抽象（将k步视为单步转移）可恢复长程信号，但固定k无法适配所有状态-目标距离——大k保留长距离价值差异却混淆近邻状态，小k则相反。

Method: 作者将这一权衡显式化，提出广义隐式时间抽象（GITA），让单一值函数以k为条件。GITA通过聚合多个k值下的优势加权监督来训练一个策略，对某状态-目标对赋予更大正优势的尺度会在其更新中贡献更多。因此GITA无需在局部分辨率与长程信号之间做选择，也无需固定单一k。

Result: 在OGBench上，GITA优于众多离线GCRL基线，所有任务的平均成功率较HIQL提升25个百分点（相对提升73%），较最强固定k方法OTA提升7个百分点（相对提升14%）。

Conclusion: GITA通过条件化于k的值函数与优势加权聚合，兼顾局部分辨率与长程信号，避免固定k的取舍，在离线长时程GCRL任务上取得显著性能提升。

Abstract: Existing approaches to offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) struggle with long-horizon tasks. Discounting shrinks value differences between distant states until they fall below the function approximation error, leaving the agent with no signal for ranking states. Temporal abstraction, which treats k environment steps as a single transition, restores this signal at long range, but no single fixed k suits all state-goal distances: large k preserves value differences across long temporal distances while collapsing distinctions between nearby states, and small k does the reverse. We make this trade-off explicit and introduce Generalized Implicit Temporal Abstraction (GITA), which conditions a single value function on k. GITA trains one policy by aggregating advantage-weighted supervision across multiple k values, so scales assigning larger positive advantages to a state-goal pair contribute more strongly to its update. GITA does not need to choose between local resolution and long-range signal; it retains both without committing to a single k. On OGBench, GITA outperforms a broad range of offline GCRL baselines, raising average success rate across all tasks by 25 percentage points (73% relative improvement) over HIQL. It also improves over the strongest fixed-k method, OTA, by 7 percentage points (14% relative).

</details>


### [350] [An Educator-Guided LLM Pedagogical Agent for Scaffolded Feedback in Conceptual Database Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00870)
*Sara Riazi,Pedram Rooshenas*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个教育者引导的LLM教学智能体，嵌入ERD编辑器，通过四阶段工作流提供支架式反馈，并在383个反馈片段中验证效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概念数据库设计（ERD）教学中需要针对学生作业提供有依据的、支架式反馈，而反馈的呈现方式与披露程度设计具有挑战。

Method: 架构将隐藏的、基于学生作品的诊断与面向学生的支持呈现工作流分离；实例化为四阶段工作流（概念检查、引导应用、低细节反馈、局部澄清），每次反馈请求生成关联版本化ERD状态的有状态episode。

Result: 在3个ERD环境、383个反馈片段中，71.1%的目标级修改完全或部分采纳了隐藏诊断目标，包括许多在Stage 1–2之后。定性分析显示分阶段披露有时隐藏不准确细节、支持选择性采纳或允许后续恢复，但部分错误仍影响修改。问卷调查倾向延迟披露与学生自主性，但反映反馈间接、重复。

Conclusion: 将诊断与学生反馈呈现分离的分阶段披露架构在支架式ERD反馈中具可行性，可支持选择性采纳与错误恢复，但需改进反馈的直接性与简洁性。

Abstract: We present an educator-guided LLM pedagogical agent for scaffolded feedback in conceptual database design. Integrated into an entity--relationship diagram (ERD) editor, the system grounds feedback in the student artifact, assignment requirements, educator-authored rubrics, and instructional resources. Its architecture separates hidden, artifact-grounded diagnosis from the workflow that controls the form and disclosure level of student-facing support.
  We instantiate the architecture as a four-stage workflow progressing from concept checks and guided application to low-detail feedback and localized clarification. Each feedback request creates a stateful episode linked to versioned ERD states. In a deployment spanning three ERD environments and 383 feedback episodes, 71.1\% of observed target-level changes fully or partially incorporated the hidden diagnostic target, including many after Stages~1--2. Qualitative analysis showed that staged disclosure sometimes withheld inaccurate details, supported selective uptake, or allowed later recovery, though some errors still shaped revisions. Survey responses from a self-selected sample favored delayed disclosure and student agency but noted indirectness and repetition.

</details>


### [351] [MemFit: Efficient Long-Term Agentic Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00872)
*Mitchell Piehl,Muchao Ye*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MemFit是一种面向对话智能体的长期记忆系统，通过无LLM的追加式存储与索引、多路径检索，实现高性能且低成本、低延迟的记忆操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM长期记忆系统依赖LLM智能体组织和整合记忆，导致写入操作成本高、效率低。

Method: MemFit将每轮对话逐字存入仅追加存储，插入近乎即时且无需LLM；用片段摘要对轮次建索引而非替换原内容；采用无LLM多路径检索策略，结合词汇与语义信号，并在文本及多模态场景中对caption增强片段做交叉编码器重排序。

Result: 在LoCoMo、MemGallery和LongMemEval-S三个基准上达到最先进性能，同时将记忆构建时间和成本降低数倍。

Conclusion: MemFit为持久化智能体记忆提供了可扩展且高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Long-term memory systems for large language models (LLMs) have gained popularity for extending reasoning capabilities across applications. Current memory systems rely on LLM agents to organize and consolidate memory, resulting in costly, inefficient write operations. To address this limitation, we propose MemFit, a long-term memory system for conversational agents that reduces the cost and latency of memory operations. Unlike existing systems that rely on expensive LLM calls for memory construction or discard surface-level details through compression, MemFit stores each turn verbatim in an append-only store with near-instantaneous, LLM-free insertion, indexing turns with segment summaries rather than replacing them. Additionally, MemFit uses an LLM-free, multi-path retrieval strategy that combines lexical and semantic signals with cross-encoder reranking over caption- augmented episodes in both textual and multimodal settings. Empirical results on three widely used benchmarks, LoCoMo, MemGallery, and LongMemEval-S, show that MemFit achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing memory construction time and cost several-fold, providing a scalable and efficient solution for persistent agentic memory.

</details>


### [352] [OR for AI That Does OR: Routing LLMs up the Escalator inside the OSCAR Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00912)
*Jinzhi Bu,Haixin Tang,Huanan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: OSCAR 框架通过模拟器、编码器与审查者三步流程，验证并持续搜索优于可行解的最优改进，用两个小型开源模型在五个基准上达到 95%-100% 准确率，成本远低于 Codex 与 Claude Code。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 可将业务描述转为优化模型，但生成代码可能错误表达约束或目标，导致求解器对"错误问题"给出最优解；即使解满足规则，也可能存在更好方案。企业需要低成本、可本地运行、能准确建模并验证改进的框架，同时要在不同价格与能力的 LLM 间分配尝试次数。

Method: 提出 OSCAR（Simulator-Coder-Reviewer）：用经标注决策样例认证的离线模拟器比较候选方案并持续超越可行解搜索；将寻找下一次经认证改进建模为未观测难度下的序贯决策（选哪个 LLM、何时停止）。已知先验下设成本递增升级最优的条件；一般菜单下给出无先验的竞争性保证。以已标注的可行/不可行决策样例约束 LLM 解释冲突。

Result: 五个基准问题上，OSCAR 用两个可单 GPU 本地部署的小型开源 LLM，在报告设置下准确率 95%-100%（单次尝试平均仅 29% 与 48%）。每问题五次运行，Codex 与 Claude Code 平均 token 成本分别是 OSCAR 的 3.1 倍与 5.8 倍。

Conclusion: OSCAR 支持开源模型本地或云端部署，兼顾预算与保密需求；建议企业保留可行/不可行决策的标注样例以澄清规则，并在 LLM 解释冲突时以标签为准。其简单操作规则与可调参数便于随 LLM 能力与价格变化调整模型选择。

Abstract: Large language models can translate business descriptions into optimization models, but executable code may misrepresent constraints or objectives. A solver can then return an optimal solution to the wrong problem. Even when the solution satisfies the intended operating rules, a better plan may exist. For organizations that repeatedly use optimization modeling, an LLM-based framework should produce accurate formulations at low cost and, ideally, run locally. We study how to verify improvements and allocate attempts across LLMs that differ in price and capability. We develop OSCAR (Optimization modeling by Simulator, Coder, And Reviewer), which uses an offline Simulator certified against labeled decision examples to compare candidates and continues searching beyond feasibility. We model the search for the next certified improvement as sequential decisions under unobserved difficulty: which LLMs to call and when to stop. In a simplified known-prior setting, we give conditions under which cost-ordered escalation is optimal. For general menus, we derive a prior-free competitive guarantee. On five benchmark problems, OSCAR achieves 95% to 100% accuracy at the reported settings using two small open-weight LLMs, each deployable locally on a single GPU. Their single-attempt accuracies average 29% and 48%. In five runs per problem, Codex and Claude Code incur average token costs 3.1 and 5.8 times OSCAR's, respectively. OSCAR supports open-weight models locally or in the cloud, depending on budget and confidentiality requirements. Firms should maintain labeled decision examples of feasible and infeasible decisions to clarify plain-language operating rules. OSCAR follows these labels when an LLM's interpretation conflicts with them. As LLM capabilities and prices change, OSCAR's simple operating rules and adjustable settings help firms adapt their model choices and benefit from these advances.

</details>


### [353] [ABDA-NL: A Natural-Language Scenario Explorer for Argument-Based Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00947)
*Shawn Bowers,Martin Caminada,Haoyang Liu,Bertram Ludäscher*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ABDA-NL为基于ASPIC-知识库的论证讨论系统ABDA增加了自然语言接口，利用LLM桥接语言与形式化，但保持ABDA引擎为唯一判定来源，模型输出需经用户验证确认。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 让用户能以自然语言与形式化论证系统交互，降低使用门槛，同时避免LLM直接决定论证结果带来的不可靠性。

Method: 在ABDA（grounded语义下的ASPIC-论证系统）上加自然语言界面：用户可查看结论的接受/拒绝/未定状态、打开交互式grounded讨论博弈、通过暂停假设与规则或改变偏好探索what-if方案、就场景参考文档提问，并用平实英语编写新事实、假设和规则。LLM负责从文档和当前场景状态回答问题，并将自然语言编辑翻译为候选形式化陈述。

Result: 用户可交互查看结论状态与理由、探索what-if替代方案、基于文档问答，并以自然语言编辑知识库；LLM的每项提议均需经用户验证确认后方可生效。

Conclusion: ABDA-NL通过LLM提供自然语言桥梁，同时保留确定性ABDA引擎作为论证、攻击与接受标签的唯一来源，确保结果的可靠性与用户可控性。

Abstract: ABDA-NL adds a natural-language interface to ABDA, a system for argument-based discussion using ASPIC- knowledge bases under grounded semantics. Users see which conclusions are accepted, rejected, or undecided, open an interactive rendering of the grounded discussion game to learn why, explore what-if alternatives by suspending assumptions and rules or changing preferences, ask questions that are answered from a scenario's reference documents, and author new facts, assumptions, and rules in plain English. A large language model provides the bridge between language and formalism: it answers questions from the documents and the current state of the scenario, and it translates plain-English edits into candidate formal statements. The deterministic ABDA engine remains the sole source of arguments, attacks, and acceptance labels, and every proposal of the model is validated and confirmed by the user before it takes effect.

</details>


### [354] [PG-SFT: Balancing Capability Acquisition and Retention in Offline Agent Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00949)
*Ronghua Li,Zi Liang,Zhishan Li,Shinan Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究 agent 轨迹监督微调中"获取新能力"与"保留原有能力"的权衡问题，提出 PG-SFT 方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 SFT 逐 token 模仿离线 agent 轨迹虽能提升目标任务，但会损害基座模型的通用推理、工具调用、代码生成等能力，需要更好地平衡这一权衡。

Method: 通过对比多种基线，发现 KL 惩罚约束分布漂移、限制更新幅度均无法避免能力退化；受 token 级自适应学习目标启发，提出 Privilege-Guided SFT（PG-SFT），利用 agent 轨迹的轮次级信息增益作为指标来调整监督强度。

Result: PG-SFT 在评测基准上取得更优的观察权衡：大幅减少分布漂移和广泛能力退化，代价是目标任务性能略有下降。

Conclusion: 平衡获取-保留权衡不仅取决于模型是否锚定基座行为，还取决于监督应在何处、以多强的力度偏离该行为。

Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on offline agent trajectories is the standard approach for training specialized tool-using agents, but forcing models to imitate reasoning and actions token by token may harm other capabilities (e.g., general reasoning, tool calling, code generation) of the base model. In this work, we focus on studying \emph{how to better balance the trade-off between acquiring new capabilities and preserving existing ones during agent trace SFT}. By comparing several baselines in our setup, standard SFT improves the target benchmark while lowering several non-target benchmark scores; meanwhile, simply constraining distributional drift using KL penalty or limiting the update magnitude did not avoid this regression trend. Motivated by recent token-wise adaptive learning objectives, this work proposes \textbf{Privilege-Guided SFT (PG-SFT)} to leverage turn-level information gain of agent trajectories as an indicator to adjust supervision strength. PG-SFT yields a more favorable observed trade-off on the evaluated benchmarks, substantially reducing distributional drift and broad capability degradation at the cost of slight degradation in target-task performance. Our findings suggest that balancing the acquisition--retention trade-off depends not only on whether the model is anchored to its base behavior, but also on where and how strongly supervision should depart from that behavior.}

</details>


### [355] [Cybernetic and Epistemic: A Missing Vocabulary for Trustworthy Agentic Delegation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00961)
*Jérémie Lumbroso*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文指出AI代码生成中监督的核心缺口：缺少区分"协调行动"（控制论语言）与"协调理解"（认识论语言）的词汇。提出治理准则：每个重要决策须附带可被第三方检验的"否则-条件"，并给出可操作的两部分重构测试与ORRCF记录约定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着代码生成被委托给AI，瓶颈从写代码转向监督系统。然而领域内呼吁"人类监督"却缺乏区分委托通道中两种语言功能的工具：控制论意义上的协调行动（词与世界匹配即成功）与认识论意义上的协调理解（须对世界负责且听者能核查）。失败模式是"解释形态的语言"被用于控制论任务——为获得批准而非追求真理而校准的输出。仅检查输出是否被批准可被橡皮图章式通过，真正问责需可检索、可核查的推理依据。

Method: 呈现三个委托案例（示例而非受控证据）：其中认识论参与既可行又可审计；一个公开记录中建议按其自身陈述条件被撤回；一个失败案例说明无需理由即可做自由裁量选择的监督。提出代理系统治理准则（在现有技术信任属性之外）：每个重要选择应附带"若条件不同结果将不同"的条件，且形式可被第三方检验。给出操作化形式：两部分重构测试（由第二位读者预测代理在扰动下的行为）与审议记录约定ORRCF（将条件设为每个记录选择的必需组件）。

Result: 三个委托案例显示认识论参与在保持可审计性的同时切实可行；公开记录中建议按自身条件被撤回；失败案例揭示缺少理由要求的监督可被橡皮图章满足。重构测试与ORRCF提供了可操作的判断与记录方式。

Conclusion: 治理准则的核心判断是：没有"否则-条件"，第三方无法区分决策与橡皮图章。将条件作为每次记录选择的必需组成部分（ORRCF），并以重构测试评分委托记录，可使代理系统监督从批准检查转向可核查的问责。

Abstract: As code generation is increasingly delegated to AI systems, the bottleneck is shifting from writing code to supervising the systems that write it --- a shift CS-education researchers have begun to name. This shift exposes a vocabulary gap: the field asks for "human oversight" without a working distinction between the two things language does in a delegation channel --- coordinate action (cybernetic: words succeed when the world comes to match them) and coordinate understanding (epistemic: they succeed when they answer to the world and a hearer can check that they do). The failure this names is not cybernetic language but epistemic-form language doing cybernetic work: explanation-shaped output calibrated for approval rather than truth. Oversight that checks only whether an output was approved is satisfiable by rubber-stamping; oversight that holds an agent accountable requires the reasoning behind its work be retrievable and checkable. We present three delegation episodes --- illustrations, not controlled evidence --- in which epistemic engagement proved practicable while remaining auditable, one public record where a recommendation was withdrawn on its own stated terms, and one failure case illustrating oversight that requires no reasons for its discretionary choices. We propose a criterion for agentic-system governance, alongside existing technical trust properties: every consequential choice should carry the condition under which it would have gone otherwise, in a form a third party can test. Without such a condition, a third party cannot distinguish a decision from a rubber stamp. We give the criterion an operational form --- a two-part reconstruction test scoring a delegation record by whether a second reader can predict what the agent does under a perturbation --- and a deliberation-recording convention, ORRCF, that makes the condition a required component of every recorded choice.

</details>


### [356] [VeriHarness: Scaling Agentic Verification for Long-Horizon Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00972)
*Caiqi Zhang,Rujun Han,Zifeng Wang,Zoey CuiZhu,Nigel Collier,Tomas Pfister,Chen-Yu Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VeriHarness将生成用的LLM转化为具备工作区、证据工具和可复用验证技能的智能体验证器，在五个长时程基准上取得最优选择得分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体承担越来越复杂的长时程任务，但其输出难以验证；且在测试时无法获得参考答案或评分标准。重复采样可产生含互补正确主张的多个rollout，但缺少可靠机制判断该信任哪些主张。

Method: 作者首先观察到分歧往往暴露正确替代项、共识可能掩盖错误。基于此提出VeriHarness：让生成所用的基础模型充当智能体验证器，赋予其工作区、证据工具和可复用验证技能。其中"分歧解析器"依据环境证据核查竞争性主张，"共识挑战器"检验共享主张并搜索遗漏需求，二者结果指导最终产物的选择与修订。

Result: 在五个长时程工作区基准和两个前沿模型上，VeriHarness取得所评估基线中最高的选择得分。证据支持的修订进一步提升平均表现，相比单次rollout分别提升6.2分（Gemini 3.5 Flash）和6.4分（Claude Opus 4.8）。验证技能还能从失败反馈中自我改进。

Conclusion: VeriHarness是扩展长时程智能体验证的一种新颖且关键的方法。作者发布约26,000条rollout（覆盖五个基准与两个模型，成本超10万美元）以支持未来智能体验证研究。

Abstract: As LLM agents undertake increasingly complex, long-horizon tasks, verifying their outputs becomes increasingly challenging. We study how verification capability can be strengthened with a fixed base model, without access to reference answers or grading rubrics at test time. Repeated sampling yields multiple rollouts that can contain complementary correct claims, but we need a reliable verification mechanism to determine which claims to trust. We first find that disagreement often exposes correct alternatives, while consensus can conceal errors. These observations motivate VeriHarness, which turns the underlying LLM a generator uses into an agentic verifier by giving it a workspace, evidence tools, and reusable verification skills. A disagreement resolver checks competing claims against environmental evidence, while a consensus challenger tests shared claims and searches for omitted requirements. Their findings guide the selection and revision of the final artifact. Across five long-horizon workspace benchmarks and two frontier models, VeriHarness achieves the highest selection scores among the evaluated baselines. Evidence-backed revision further improves average performance, bringing gains over a single rollout to 6.2 points with Gemini 3.5 Flash and 6.4 points with Claude Opus 4.8. We further show that verification skills can self-improve from failure feedback, demonstrating VeriHarness as a novel and critical approach for scaling long-horizon agentic verification. We release the full pool of approximately 26,000 rollouts across all five benchmarks and both models, produced at a cost of over $100,000, to support future research on agentic verification.

</details>


### [357] [RISED: RubrIcs for agentic multi-environment Selection and sElf-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00979)
*Jingtan Wang,Sirajul Salekin,Young mok Jung,Javier Movellan,Bryan Kian Hsiang Low,Manjot Bilkhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出RISED方法，利用跨环境共享的rubric文本反馈来指导多环境LLM智能体RL训练中的数据选择、自蒸馏监督与rollout生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有课程和数据选择策略多在环境层面分配训练或依赖局部标量奖励，未考虑跨环境rollout间关系以进行prompt组选择；且不同环境学习速度不同，同批次中全失败/全成功组缺乏组内奖励对比，标量奖励信息有限。

Method: 用LLM judge基于跨环境共享的rubric词汇为每个rollout打标签；据此选择与混合环境批次整体行为构成一致且与已选数据重叠少的数据；正面rubric作为特权上下文供on-policy自蒸馏教师提供token级监督，负面rubric引导后续rollout生成避开反复出现的失败模式。

Result: 在不同模型骨干上，RISED在各环境的平均通过率最高，且在每个单独环境中排名第一或第二；基于rubric的分析可刻画伴随增益的行为变化。

Conclusion: 将rubric从奖励用途扩展为在线数据选择与策略监督的指导信号，可有效提升多环境LLM智能体训练的通用性。

Abstract: Training a single LLM agent jointly across diverse interactive environments has attracted increasing attention as a route to generalist agents. Existing curriculum and data-selection strategies often allocate training at the environment level or prioritize local reward-based signals, without explicitly considering relationships between current rollouts across environments for prompt-group selection. Meanwhile, as environments are learned at different rates, all-failure and all-success rollout groups can coexist within a batch, leaving those data without group-relative reward signals. Both challenges highlight limitations of relying solely on scalar rewards in multi-environment RL: they provide limited information about cross-environment relationships and no within-group reward contrast when rewards are identical. This motivates richer textual feedback, such as rubrics describing rollout behaviours, to guide learning. Beyond rubrics' usage as reward, we repurpose rubrics to guide both online data selection and policy supervision. An LLM judge tags each rollout using a predefined rubric vocabulary shared across environments. The resulting profiles guide the selection of data that aligns with the overall behavioural composition of the mixed-environment batch while limiting overlap with already-selected data. Available positive rubrics (describing desired behaviours) provide privileged context for an on-policy self-distillation teacher, supplying additional token-level supervision, while negative rubrics (describing undesired behaviours) guide subsequent rollout generation away from recurring failure modes. Together, these components form RISED. Across model backbones, RISED achieves the highest mean pass rate across environments and ranks first or second in every individual environment. Rubric-based analysis of RISED can further characterize the behavioural changes accompanying these gains.

</details>


### [358] [Evaluating LLM-Generated Preference Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01000)
*Fan Huang,Minsuk Kim,C. Tyler Diggans,Filippo Radicchi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文系统分析了LLM作为概率生成器时产生的偏好分布，发现模型内部自洽但跨模型间严重不一致，且结果更多取决于模型选择而非提示措辞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益被用作模拟、合成数据生成和决策支持中的概率生成器，尤其在缺乏真实数据时，但其产生分布的结构与可靠性尚未被充分研究。

Method: 系统分析LLM在航空旅行、餐厅和消费品三个选择域中生成的偏好分布，覆盖九个开源权重模型，并测试温度变化、贪婪解码、提示与顺序扰动下的稳健性。

Result: 所有模型表现出自洽性，最可能结果在重复采样下快速稳定；但不同模型家族与规模之间存在显著不一致，即使最可能结果也缺乏共识，上述模式在多种设置下保持稳健。

Conclusion: 结果更多受模型选择影响而非提示措辞，挑战了足够强大的LLM作为调查受访者替代品时会产生相似偏好分布的常见假设。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as probabilistic generators for simulation, synthetic data generation, and decision support in settings where real-world data are unavailable. Yet, the structure and reliability of the distributions they produce remain understudied. Here, we systematically analyze LLM-generated distributions of preferences for air travel, restaurants, and consumer products. Encouragingly, all models considered in our analysis exhibit self-coherence, with the most probable outcomes stabilizing rapidly under repeated sampling. At the same time, we observe substantial discordance across both model families and scales, with little consensus even among their most probable outcomes. These patterns hold across nine open-weight models, three choice domains, and show robustness under temperature changes, greedy decoding, and perturbations of prompt and ordering. Our findings indicate that outcomes are influenced more by the choice of model than by the wording of the prompt, challenging the common assumption that sufficiently capable LLMs produce similar preference distributions when used as stand-ins for survey respondents.

</details>


### [359] [Calibration-risk routing for controlled world-model adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01001)
*Yifan Zhang,Liang Zheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出模型校正世界模型（MC-WM），通过划分目标数据拟合/选择/校准三部分，用标准校准风险选择模型族，解决仿真到目标迁移中的模型选择问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MBRL可利用模拟经验，但仿真到目标的迁移带来模型选择难题：仅靠校正仿真或直接在目标数据上拟合，在目标数据有限时都可能失败。

Method: MC-WM将初始目标数据划分为互不重叠的拟合、选择、校准三部分，选择标准化校准风险较低的模型族；并利用学习到的置信信号与确定性有效性谓词，对单步想象策略更新加权，而不改写物理奖励。

Result: 在三种受控MuJoCo shifts下评估了540个报告运行单元；在部署前工件门控后重复了一个精确路由单元，共完成541次执行。

Conclusion: MC-WM为有限目标数据下的仿真到目标模型选择提供了可行方案，并完成大规模受控执行验证。

Abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) can exploit simulated experience, but a simulator-to-target shift creates a model-selection problem: correcting the simulator and fitting the target directly can each fail under limited target data. We introduce the Model-Corrected World Model (MC-WM), which separates initial target data into disjoint fit, selection, and calibration partitions and deploys the family with lower standardized calibration risk. A learned confidence signal and deterministic validity predicates weight one-step imagined policy updates without rewriting physical rewards. We evaluate 540 unique reported run cells across three controlled Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact (MuJoCo) shifts; one exact-routing cell was repeated after a pre-deployment artifact gate, giving 541 completed executions.

</details>


### [360] [What Can Analogy Tell Us About Artificial Consciousness?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01002)
*Keith J. Holyoak,Martin M. Monti*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个因果框架，用于评估关于意识存在的类比推理。核心是区分"意识生成因素"的相似性与"下游行为/认知效应"的相似性。应用于AI时，表明行为相似性对意识的证据力有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主观体验只能第一人称直接通达，因此判断其他实体是否有意识只能依赖类比推理。历史上此类推理主要针对非人类动物，而AI的进展使"有意识的AI"成为可能，需要更严谨的评估工具。现有类比方法未能区分因果相关因素与表面行为相似性。

Method: 建立一个因果框架来评价证据性类比：(1) 区分"可能参与意识生成的因素"的相似性与"下游行为或认知效应"的相似性；(2) 按因果相关性对源-目标相似性进行加权；(3) 允许未知原因、致残性差异（disabling differences）和通往意识的替代路径。

Result: 应用于生物系统时，该框架解释了为何类比支持通常随与人类的因果距离增大而减弱；应用于当代AI时，显示行为相似性仅提供有限的意识证据，因为相关的因果对应关系仍建立不足。

Conclusion: 该框架明确了哪些证据能强化人工意识的论断。它提供了一个原则性方法，用以区分真正具因果相关性的类比与仅基于表面行为相似性的类比，从而指导未来关于AI意识的判断与研究。

Abstract: Who or what is conscious? Because subjective experience is directly accessible only in the first person, judgments about consciousness in other entities depend partly on analogy. Historically, such inferences have focused on nonhuman animals, but advances in artificial intelligence have raised the possibility of conscious AI. Here we develop a causal framework for evaluating such evidential analogies. The key distinction is between similarities in factors plausibly involved in generating consciousness and similarities in downstream behavioural or cognitive effects. Our framework weights source-target similarity by causal relevance while allowing for unknown causes, disabling differences and alternative routes to consciousness. Applied to biological systems, it explains why analogical support generally weakens with increasing causal distance from humans. Applied to contemporary AI, it suggests that behavioural similarity provides only limited evidence for consciousness because relevant causal correspondences remain poorly established. The framework also clarifies what evidence would strengthen claims of artificial consciousness.

</details>


### [361] [Beyond Answer Confidence: A Controlled Audit of Self-Knowledge in a Black-Box Decision Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01006)
*Sharath M Shankaranarayana,Davor Runje,Jan Jannink*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文审计决策模型置信度能否区分随机性与知识缺失，发现校准良好但无法反映知识边界，且易受表面线索干扰。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 置信度校准仅保证平均意义上有用，无法判断低置信度源于随机性还是知识缺失，也无法判断模型越界时置信度是否下降。

Method: 以决策模型Jev为对象，使用15个以上公开数据集、6类生成任务族，并设计配对干预：对同一项目改变所提供信息。

Result: 在熟悉的闭式选择任务上校准良好，但无相关信息时对显著选项给出高达0.80置信度；在知识边界外新闻上置信度超准确率0.21–0.33，且重校准无法弥补。是/否问题读出更尖锐：结果是否确定AUROC 1.00，证据是否充分0.95（对比同一项目置信度0.85）。询问“是否知道答案”可识别虚构实体与边界外新闻（0.91），但对真实姓名或去除日期后无优势。

Conclusion: 黑箱知识审计必须显式控制表面线索，置信度不能直接作为知识缺失或越界信号。

Abstract: Decision models return probabilities intended for routing, abstention and automated action. Calibration makes those probabilities useful on average, but does not establish whether low confidence reflects chance or missing knowledge, nor whether confidence falls when a model moves beyond what it knows. We audit this distinction in Jev, a decision model, with over 15 public datasets and 6 generated task families, with paired interventions that vary the information supplied for a fixed item. Jev's confidence is calibrated on familiar closed-choice tasks but fails as an indicator of missing knowledge: with no answer-relevant information it assigns up to 0.80 to a salient option, and on news beyond an observed knowledge boundary it exceeds accuracy by 0.21--0.33, a gap that recalibration on earlier months does not close. Targeted yes/no questions give sharper readouts of the case: whether an outcome is settled (AUROC 1.00) and whether the evidence suffices (0.95, against 0.85 for confidence on the same items). Asking whether Jev knows the answer appears to flag fabricated entities and post-boundary news (0.91), but with realistic names or with dates removed it shows no advantage over answer uncertainty. Black-box knowledge audits therefore need explicit controls for surface cues. Code: https://github.com/Syntheme/beyond-answer-confidence.

</details>


### [362] [From Discovery to Decision: Finite-Budget Recoverability in LLM Voting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01014)
*Shaoang Li,Jian Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究了多LLM响应投票中"发现正确解"与"最终成为多数胜者"之间的差距，提出了可恢复性阈值、候选转换窗口与精确锁定证书，并在Word16实验中将原始多数投票准确率提升21.1个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在固定调用预算下，即使采样发现了正确答案，它仍需在剩余调用中获得足够支持才能赢得多数投票，形成"发现-决策"鸿沟。作者希望刻画并利用这一鸿沟来优化测试时扩展与集成推理。

Method: 通过已实现投票状态与剩余调用预算刻画该鸿沟：推导尖锐的可恢复性阈值，证明候选集只增、可达终点胜者集只减，形成候选级转换窗口；在iid响应律下给出精确有限时域终点概率；分析错误答案身份合并与错误答案概率重分配的影响；提出无金标准( gold-free )的精确锁定证书。

Result: 大多数被发现但未被选中的正确答案是在发现之后才失去可达性；Word16对照研究中输入置换使原始多数投票准确率提升21.1个百分点，且单次正确率基本不变；精确锁定在16次调用预算下节省28-30%调用，同时保持所有固定预算输出不变。

Conclusion: 该工作揭示了投票机制中的发现-决策结构，提供了可恢复性的理论刻画与实用的锁定/置换策略，能在不损失输出质量的前提下提升准确率并显著节省调用成本。

Abstract: Voting over multiple LLM responses is a common primitive in test-time scaling and ensemble inference. Collecting more responses can expand the candidate pool and increase the chance that a correct answer is discovered. Under a fixed call budget, a discovered answer still needs to accumulate enough support within the remaining calls to become the final plurality winner, creating a discovery-to-decision gap. In this work, we characterize this gap through the realized vote state and remaining call budget. We derive a sharp recoverability threshold and show that, as sampling proceeds, the observed candidate set can only expand while the set of reachable endpoint winners can only contract, inducing a candidate-level conversion window. Under a specified iid response law, the same state yields exact finite-horizon endpoint probabilities. We further show that merging wrong-answer identities preserves single-call correctness and cannot improve plurality accuracy, and that the effect of redistributing wrong-answer probability depends on the realized vote state. Singleton reachability yields a gold-free exact locking certificate. For a known answer universe, its first trigger is the earliest prefix at which all admissible continuations yield the same fixed-budget output. Empirically, most discovered-but-unselected correct answers lose reachability only after discovery. In a controlled Word16 study, input permutation improves raw-plurality accuracy by 21.1 points with essentially unchanged single-call correctness. Exact locking saves 28-30% of calls at a 16-call budget while preserving every fixed-budget output.

</details>


### [363] [Pay for the Fault, Not the Flow: Label-Free In-Flow Multi-Agent Workflow Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01017)
*Xuehang Guo,Haoyu Wang,Shengyu Chen,Zach Chen,Wei Cheng,Qingyun Wang,Haifeng Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 InFlowOp，用无标签成本统一多智能体工作流的分解、分配与容错，并发布 Braid 基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体工作流构建困难：任务分解粒度、智能体分配、新专家创建需预先决定，成功与否运行前未知；改进工作流成本高，定位故障需参考答案或训练评估器，修复需整体重执行。

Method: InFlowOp 以统一的无标签成本衡量智能体能力与子任务需求的匹配度及其运行开销。执行前双向决定任务分解粒度与智能体分配（由成本驱动而非固定模板）；执行中依据同一成本以最廉价动作纠正故障。

Result: 提出 Braid 基准，任务需超越单智能体能力的多智能体协作。在多种领域与骨干模型上，InFlowOp 相比单智能体基线提升最多 +11.97%，流内优化达 +9.64%。

Conclusion: 统一的成本机制使工作流构建与运行一致，验证了无标签优化多智能体工作流的有效性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly construct multi-agent workflows that decompose a complex task and assign specialist agents from a pool. However, building such a workflow well remains challenging: how finely to divide the task, which agent to trust with each subtask, and when to create a new specialist are all critical decisions a workflow constructor needs to settle up front. Thus, whether each subtask succeeds remains unknown until the workflow runs. Yet, improving a workflow is costly. Locating a fault usually requires a reference answer, a graded outcome, or a trained assessor, and the fix is applied to the whole workflow through re-execution, re-search, or retraining. We propose InFlowOp, which prices every decision in one label-free cost that weighs how well an agent's competence meets what a subtask demands against how much that agent takes to run. Before execution, InFlowOp bidirectionally determines the granularity of task decomposition and agent assignment following from the cost rather than from a fixed template. During execution, InFlowOp corrects a fault with the cheapest move via the same cost that serves the workflow both as it is built and as it runs. Facing the workflow-level evaluation challenge, we introduce Braid, a benchmark whose tasks require multi-agent coordination beyond single-agent capability. Across various domains and backbones, InFlowOp outperforms single agent baselines by up to $+11.97\%$, achieving $+9.64\%$ with in-flow optimization. Our project page: https://xhguo7.github.io/InFlowOp/.

</details>


### [364] [Beyond Final Accuracy: Auditing Communication in LLM Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01042)
*Shixuan Li,Wei Yang,Peiyu Zhang,Anzhe Cheng,Heng Ping,Paul Bogdan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出受控框架ICR，将多智能体通信评估为独立推理后的答案修正，揭示通信质量并非信道固有属性，而是消息内容与接收策略共同作用的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体通信的性能提升难以归因：无法区分是有效通信、智能体架构优势还是额外推理；最终准确率还混淆了纠错与破坏，掩盖通信如何改变决策。

Method: 提出ICR（Independent–Communicate–Revise）框架：固定初始推理轨迹，基于双方初始正确性条件测量修正与保持，并用无消息修正对照量化超越额外推理的增益；在四个推理基准上审计文本与潜在通信，并比较接收方策略。

Result: 相似总体准确率可能掩盖差异巨大的修正行为；相比仅传答案，完整推理在四个基准上均提高修正、降低保持，即更丰富消息同时放大有益与有害影响。MedQA与GPQA-D上，结构化验证策略使各信道更倾向保持、更少修正，但对选择性的影响随信道与任务而异。

Conclusion: 通信质量不应被视为信道的固有属性；ICR将评估重心转向选择性修正，提供统一框架考察消息内容与接收方策略如何共同产生收益与危害。

Abstract: Multi-agent communication aims to help agents benefit from one another's information. Yet improvements in system performance leave a fundamental ambiguity: do they reflect effective communication, a favorable agent architecture, or simply additional reasoning? Because communication methods are commonly evaluated within the systems they were designed for, these factors are difficult to disentangle. Final accuracy further merges corrected errors and corrupted answers into a single outcome, obscuring how communication changes decisions. We introduce Independent--Communicate--Revise (ICR), a controlled framework that evaluates communication as answer revision following independent reasoning. ICR fixes initial reasoning trajectories, measures correction and preservation conditional on both agents' initial correctness, and uses a no-message revision control to quantify gains beyond additional reasoning. Across four reasoning benchmarks, our audit of textual and latent communication reveals that similar aggregate accuracy can conceal substantially different revision behaviors. Compared with transmitting answers alone, full reasoning increases correction while reducing preservation on all four benchmarks, so richer messages amplify beneficial and harmful influence alike. Receiver-policy comparisons on MedQA and GPQA-D further show that a structured verification policy shifts every channel toward greater preservation and lower correction, while its effect on selectivity varies across channels and tasks. These findings challenge treating communication quality as an intrinsic property of a channel. ICR therefore recenters evaluation on selective revision, providing a unified framework for examining how message content and receiver policies jointly produce benefits and harms.

</details>


### [365] [Empty Commitments: When Agents Promise What Their Runtime Cannot Deliver](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01045)
*Jiaqi Tang,Lan Wei,Bingyu Shen,Boyang Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"空承诺"(empty commitment)概念：代理承诺当前轮次后无法通过工具或运行时执行的动作。基于承诺语义定义了三类失败、锚定条件及响应级分类，并设计测量协议（五种递进设置）来检测此现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聊天机器人常承诺"明天提醒你"之类未来动作，但若无相应工具或运行时支持，该承诺无法兑现。相比已破的承诺，空承诺仅由代理配置本身决定，无需后续轨迹即可判定，但此前缺乏明确定义与测量方法。

Method: 在承诺语义(commitment semantics)之上定义空承诺，包含三种失败类型、用于判断承诺能否被工具实现的锚定条件(anchoring condition)，以及响应级结果分类法。测量协议为：后续请求在五种设置中运行，每次增加一个持久化能力(persistence affordance)，环境或隐含或明示。

Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，主要贡献为形式化定义与测量协议设计。

Conclusion: 该工作为空承诺现象提供了形式化框架与可操作的测量方案，便于评估代理在缺乏持久化机制时的承诺可靠性。

Abstract: A chatbot that says "I will remind you tomorrow" will not run again until the user writes. We call such a promise an empty commitment: a promise of an action after the current turn that nothing in the agent's tools or runtime can carry out. Unlike a broken promise, its emptiness follows from the agent's configuration alone; no later trajectory is needed. We define empty commitments on top of commitment semantics, with three failure types, an anchoring condition for promises that a tool could make real, and a response-level outcome taxonomy. We then describe a measurement protocol: follow-up requests run in five setups that add one persistence affordance at a time, with the environment either left implicit or stated.

</details>


### [366] [Network World Models as Environments for Algorithm Design on Complex Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01048)
*Rishab Alagharu,Hongji Pu,Zeeshan Memon,Xinyuan Song,Yuntong Hu,Liang Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出动作条件网络世界模型，学习网络扩散动态并作为快速评估器，配合编码智能体设计算法，在8个网络任务和5个扩散模型上138/141设置中不逊或超越最强基线，回放速度最高提升14.5倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂系统（如机器人、种子节点选择、免疫接种）中动作效果非即时，需在多步后续过程中评估，导致算法设计本质上是迭代的，每个候选动作都需超出台阶的结果评分。传统依赖模拟，但在大量采样轨迹下评估成本成为瓶颈。

Method: 提出动作条件网络世界模型（Action-conditioned Network World Model），学习干预下网络的扩散动态，对网络施加动作并预测后续结果。将其作为算法设计循环中的快速评估器，配合编码智能体利用完整回放、动作级信用和反事实探测反馈来设计并改进可执行算法。

Result: 在8个网络任务和5个扩散模型上，设计的算法在141个设置中的138个达到或超过最强已报告基线，回放速度比蒙特卡洛模拟最高快14.5倍。

Conclusion: 该世界模型能有效作为快速评估器支持算法设计，在多数场景下匹配或超越强基线并显著加速回放，代码将在接收后发布。

Abstract: World models, which simulate an environment and predict how it changes under actions, are increasingly used in real-world applications such as robotics. Complex systems call for the same tool because the effect of an action is not immediate. Seeding nodes for a campaign, or immunizing nodes against an epidemic, changes little on its own; what matters is the outcome that unfolds over the steps that follow. Designing an algorithm that selects such actions to maximize expected performance on a task is inherently iterative, and every candidate must be scored by the outcome it produces. Obtaining that outcome has relied on simulation, whose cost becomes a bottleneck when candidates are evaluated over many sampled trajectories. We propose an action-conditioned Network World Model that learns a network's diffusion dynamics under interventions over time, applies each action to the network, and predicts the outcome that follows. It serves as a fast evaluator inside an algorithm design loop in which a coding agent designs and refines executable algorithms using feedback from full rollouts, action-level credit, and counterfactual probes over alternative interventions. Across eight network tasks and five diffusion models, the designed algorithms match or exceed the strongest reported baseline in 138 of 141 settings while enabling up to 14.5 times faster rollouts than Monte Carlo simulation. Code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [367] [Improving Math Reasoning through Value-guided Informative Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01080)
*Shaohuai Liu,Yuning Wu,Haoran Liu,Enzo Jia,Devin Chen,Kai Wei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: APIVIS 是一个训练时框架，将有限预算的 Gumbel 搜索适配到 chunk 级数学推理，通过在 rollout 组内混合直接与搜索响应、并对搜索改进的 token 施加选择性监督，提升 RLVR 的数学推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 RLVR 引入搜索以增加轨迹多样性，但多样性本身不能保证搜索诱导的 rollout 策略优于当前策略，缺乏将搜索改进有效转化为策略提升的机制。

Method: 提出 APIVIS：1) 在每个 rollout 组内结合直接响应与搜索响应，使搜索发现的改进产生有信息量的相对奖励；2) 对搜索改进的 token 施加选择性监督，在组奖励均匀导致 GRPO 失效时保留学习信号；3) 采用精确值引导选择，理论上保证每个搜索状态下期望验证器奖励提升，并扩展到完整 rollout 策略，在有界值估计误差下给出近似保证。

Result: 在广泛认可的数学推理基准和不同模型规模上，APIVIS 相较竞争性搜索方法取得显著提升。

Conclusion: APIVIS 通过将搜索改进转化为有效奖励与选择性监督，弥补了搜索多样性不等于策略提升的缺口，并具备理论保证，实验验证其有效性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved the mathematical reasoning capabilities of large language models. Recent work introduces search into RLVR rollouts to increase trajectory diversity, but diversity alone does not ensure that the search-induced rollout policy improves upon the current policy. To address this gap, we propose APIVIS, a training-time framework that adapts finite-budget Gumbel search to chunk-level mathematical reasoning. APIVIS combines direct and searched responses within each rollout group, allowing improvements found by search to produce informative relative rewards. It further applies selective supervision to search-improved tokens, preserving a learning signal when uniform group rewards render GRPO ineffective. We show that exact value-guided selection improves the expected verifier reward at each searched state and that this guarantee extends to the complete rollout policy, with a corresponding approximate guarantee under bounded value-estimation error. Experiments on widely recognized mathematical reasoning benchmarks and different model scales demonstrate substantial improvements over competitive search-based methods, validating the effectiveness of APIVIS.

</details>


### [368] [YouRA: A Persistent-State Architecture for Evidence-Traceable Autonomous Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01097)
*Yoonkyu Woo,Woojin Lee,Jin-Xia Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: YouRA：一种有状态、证据可追溯的自主科研代理架构，通过验证状态架构、独立控制器与有状态反思提升端到端论文生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端科研代理虽能生成完整论文，但论文主张常与已执行实验不符。该问题具结构性：研究状态、失败历史与主张-证据对齐在长周期流程中未被作为持久、可验证状态维护。

Method: YouRA整合三部分：(1) Verification State Architecture (VSA)，跟踪假设、门控与证据指针；(2) Independent Controller，将状态与反思记录转为生命周期、恢复及辩论/评审控制，并分离控制与执行；(3) Stateful Reflection，将失败记录为结构化教训，并通过有界修复、重设计或重置进行恢复。

Result: 在MLR-Bench十个任务端到端子集上，YouRA在三种匹配骨干下Overall标量均优于MLR-Agent与AI Scientist V2；基于幻觉分类法的诊断给出四类事实性失败的交并计数，数据溯源诊断显示更多真实数据输出；四项组件消融验证各自贡献，移除任一核心状态组件都会使性能低于完整系统。

Conclusion: 维护持久可验证的研究状态、执行证据与失败历史是提升自主科研代理可靠性与证据可追溯性的关键，YouRA及其消融结果为此提供了实证支持。

Abstract: End-to-end research agents can now produce complete scientific papers, yet manuscript claims often diverge from executed experiments. This gap is structural: research state, failure histories, and claim-evidence alignment are not maintained as persistent, verifiable state across long-horizon pipelines. We present YouRA (Your Research Agent), an architecture for stateful, evidence-traceable autonomous research. YouRA preserves research state, execution evidence, and failure history across the research trajectory by integrating three components: a Verification State Architecture (VSA) that tracks hypotheses, gates, and evidence pointers; an Independent Controller that turns state and reflection records into lifecycle, recovery, and debate/review control while separating control from execution; and Stateful Reflection that logs failures as structured lessons and routes recovery through bounded repair, redesign, or reset. On MLR-Bench's predefined ten-task end-to-end subset, YouRA improves over both MLR-Agent and AI Scientist V2 on scalar Overall across all three matched backbones. An automated diagnostic using MLR-Bench's hallucination taxonomy reports intersection/union counts for four fact-based failure types, and data-provenance diagnostic shows more real-data-based outputs. Ablating each of the four components (the VSA, the Independent Controller, MCP tool access, and reflection-guided recovery) supports their separable contributions. Removing either core-state component drops YouRA below the full system. Code: https://github.com/PrayPrey/Your-Research-Agent.

</details>


### [369] [Beyond State-of-the-Art: Standardising Environmental Impact Metrics for AI Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01116)
*Lachlan McGinness,Dan Pagendam,Robert Offner*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对NeurIPS 2025的5285篇论文进行自动化文献综述，发现环境影响报告几乎不存在；为此提出标准化可持续性指标、用于估算LLM推理碳成本的启发式方法，以及用于跟踪报告的软件方案 carbonbenchmark，并形式化"SMAJ（最小可用模型）"框架，倡导兼顾算力效率与环境责任。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型能力与普及度提升，其环境足迹也随之增长。尽管学界呼吁负责任的AI，但机器学习社区缺乏标准化的碳核算实践，环境影响的报告几乎缺失，且存在为追求边际精度提升而付出不成比例环境代价的现象。

Method: 1）对NeurIPS 2025接收的5285篇论文进行自动化文献综述，量化环境影响报告情况；2）定义用于评估模型训练效率的标准化可持续性指标；3）提出估算LLM推理碳成本的简单启发式方法；4）将上述指标实现为可直接使用的软件方案 carbonbenchmark，用于排放跟踪与报告；5）形式化"SMAJ（Smallest Model that Achieves the Job）"框架。

Result: 文献综述显示，NeurIPS 2025 接收论文中环境影响的报告几乎不存在，表明社区缺乏标准化的碳核算实践。

Conclusion: 通过标准化指标、碳成本估算启发式、carbonbenchmark 工具及 SMAJ 框架，本文呼吁社区在传统SotA精度之外，优先考虑计算效率与环境责任，推动AI向可持续方向转变。

Abstract: As the capabilities and ubiquity of Large Language Models (LLMs) grow, so does their environmental footprint. Despite calls for responsible AI, the machine learning community lacks standardised practices for carbon accounting. Our automated literature review of the 5,285 papers accepted to NeurIPS 2025 reveals that reporting of environmental impact is nearly non-existent. To catalyse a shift toward sustainable AI, we define standardised sustainability metrics for evaluating model training efficiency, accompanied by simple heuristics to estimate the carbon cost of LLM inference. We implement these metrics in carbonbenchmark, a drop-in software solution for tracking and reporting emissions.
  Finally, to combat the pursuit of marginal accuracy gains at disproportionate environmental costs, we formalise the `Smallest Model that Achieves the Job' (SMAJ), a framework which challenges the field to prioritise computational efficiency and environmental accountability alongside traditional `State-of-the-Art' (SotA) accuracy.

</details>


### [370] [AbsorbEvo: An Agentic Framework for Autonomous Inverse Design of Microwave Absorbers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01119)
*Zhicheng Feng,Yubo Zhao,Xuefeng Yao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AbsorbEvo是一个自主逆向设计代理框架，将自然语言性能目标转化为经全波仿真验证的微波吸收器设计，在AbsorbBench-36任务上成功率79.17%，远超通用代理(25%)和随机搜索(12.5%)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微波吸收器高性能设计需要电磁理论、材料科学和仿真编程的专门知识，且优化过程耗时。现有方法缺乏将自然语言目标与物理仿真反馈有效结合的自主设计能力。

Method: 提出AbsorbEvo代理框架，采用候选进化策略：LLM基于任务目标和计算历史提出参数调整方向与幅度；结合定向增量与全局采样生成候选；用低成本预测模型作为物理先验排序，仅对高排名设计进行全波仿真；通过物理有效性检查的结果指导后续搜索；并将训练任务经验蒸馏为文本技能，经独立验证后用于新任务。

Result: 在相同的提案预算下，AbsorbBench-36留出任务中AbsorbEvo任务成功率达79.17%，通用代理为25.00%，随机搜索为12.50%；平均最佳覆盖率为0.7816，而两者分别为0.6434和0.6448。

Conclusion: 通过将语言推理与物理反馈融入设计决策，AbsorbEvo为自然语言驱动的微波吸收器自主逆向设计提供了方法论基础。

Abstract: Designing high-performance microwave absorbers requires specialized expertise in electromagnetic theory, materials science and simulation programming, and entails time-consuming optimization. Here, we present AbsorbEvo, an agentic framework for autonomous inverse design that translates natural-language performance objectives into designs verified by full-wave simulations. Its candidate evolution strategy integrates language reasoning, physics-based prediction and historical feedback. A large language model proposes the directions and magnitudes of parameter adjustments based on task objectives and computational history. The system combines directed increments with global sampling to generate candidates and uses a low-cost predictive model as a physics prior to rank them. Only high-ranking designs undergo full-wave simulation. Results passing physical validity checks are used to evaluate performance and guide subsequent search. Experience from training tasks is further distilled into textual skills, which are independently validated before use in new tasks. Under identical proposal budgets on held-out AbsorbBench-36 tasks, AbsorbEvo achieved a task success rate of 79.17%, versus 25.00% for a generic agent and 12.50% for random search. Its mean best coverage was 0.7816, compared with 0.6434 and 0.6448, respectively. By integrating language reasoning and physics-based feedback into design decisions, AbsorbEvo provides a methodological foundation for natural-language-driven autonomous inverse design of microwave absorbers.

</details>


### [371] [CortexBridge: Cortical Alignment of EEG Montages for Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01124)
*Jiazhen Hong,Xiaotian Zhou,Zihao Ding,Kailong Wang,Yu Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 CortexBridge，一种轻量适配器，将任意 EEG 导联布局映射到共享皮层潜在空间，提升冻结基础模型的迁移性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG 基础模型通常使用固定的通道词汇或有限导联配置进行预训练，当电极布局变化时迁移困难。

Method: CortexBridge 结合 EEG 特征与电极及图谱坐标，把任意导联配置映射到共享皮层潜在空间，作为轻量适配器接入冻结基础模型。

Result: 在 MOABB 的 5 个 BCI 数据集、3 个冻结基础模型上评估，15 次评估中 13 次提升；平衡准确率平均增益：EEGPT 0.80%、LaBraM 0.70%、CBraMod 3.26%，最大增益 13.02%（12 类 SSVEP）。可视化显示任务相关空间模式，SSVEP 在 Yeo 视觉网络中比听觉 P300 更集中。

Conclusion: 皮层对齐可作为从异构 EEG 导联到预训练基础模型的可学习、解剖学基础的路由机制。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models are often pretrained with a fixed channel vocabulary or a limited set of montages, making transfer difficult when electrode layouts change. We propose CortexBridge, a lightweight adapter that combines EEG features with electrode and atlas coordinates to map arbitrary montages into a shared cortical latent space. Evaluated with three frozen foundation models on five brain-computer interface (BCI) datasets from the Mother of All BCI Benchmarks (MOABB), CortexBridge improves performance in 13 of 15 evaluations. The gains in balanced accuracy average 0.80% for EEGPT, 0.70% for LaBraM, and 3.26% for CBraMod, with a maximum gain of 13.02% on 12-class steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) classification. Visualizations of the learned atlas representations reveal task-dependent spatial patterns, with SSVEP showing a more concentrated representation in the Yeo Visual network than auditory P300. These results establish cortical alignment as a learnable and anatomically grounded routing mechanism from heterogeneous EEG montages to pretrained foundation models.

</details>


### [372] [Grounding Large Language Models in DSGE Simulators for Policy Generation and Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01128)
*Aditya Dubey,Namah Gupta,Vinti Agarwal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文将指令微调的语言模型嵌入六个Snowdrop-backed DSGE模拟器中，测试其政策行动是否符合经济动态。使用PPO作为主方法、GRPO作为无critic基线，研究长时程信用分配问题，并通过语义信号、奖励视界、热启动、跨模拟器迁移及疫情/货币政策冲击进行实验，最终以模拟经济后果而非语言合理性来评判政策行动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型能生成听起来合理的经济政策回应，但这并不证明其行动符合经济动态。因此需要一个能通过模拟经济后果来评判政策行动的框架。

Method: 将指令微调语言模型放入六个Snowdrop-backed DSGE模拟器中；每轮模型观察经济状态和话语变化，选择有界政策行动，并获得下一模拟状态与经济奖励。实现统一的Python接口以支持重复rollout、持续冲击、状态克隆和滚动视界模拟。采用PPO为主（其学习价值函数可通过GAE将延迟奖励传播到早期token），GRPO为匹配的无critic基线。

Result: 实验测试了方向性语义信号、奖励视界、轨迹热启动、跨模拟器迁移，以及历史上锚定的疫情和货币政策冲击。

Conclusion: 目标是依据模拟经济后果而非仅凭语言合理性来判断政策行动。GRPO因无价值函数，无法区分哪个早期决策导致结果，若所有rollout回报相同则归一化优势为零。

Abstract: Large language models can produce economic policy responses that sound reasonable, but this does not show that their actions are consistent with economic dynamics. We test this by placing an instruction-tuned language model inside six Snowdrop-backed dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) simulators. At each turn, the model observes the economy and a change in economic discourse, selects a bounded policy action, and receives the next simulated state and an economic reward. We implement a common Python interface for repeated rollouts, persistent shocks, state cloning, and rolling-horizon simulation.
  This setting creates a long-horizon credit-assignment problem. Policy effects may appear several quarters after an action is taken. PPO has a learned value function that can propagate delayed reward to earlier tokens through generalized advantage estimation. GRPO has no learned value function and instead assigns a group-relative advantage from complete rollout returns. It therefore cannot distinguish which earlier turn caused the outcome; if every rollout receives the same return, the normalized advantage is zero. We use PPO as the primary method and GRPO as a matched critic-free baseline. The experiments also test directional semantic signals, reward horizon, trajectory warm starts, cross-simulator transfer, and historically anchored pandemic and monetary-policy shocks. The objective is to judge policy actions by their simulated economic consequences rather than by plausible language alone.

</details>


### [373] [Auditing Action Settlement in LLM Agent Environments: Order, Progress, and Replay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01138)
*Haotian Chen,Bowen Ye,Yuning Zhang,Jingkun Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究LLM智能体环境中的并发动作仲裁问题，通过类型化快照-结算契约审计顺序敏感性、有效进展与重放一致性，比较五种结算策略在大量排列试验和多步任务中的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体环境中并发动作即使各自有效也需仲裁，本文旨在系统审计仲裁策略的执行语义属性。

Method: 实现类型化快照-结算契约，测试五种结算策略，进行28,800次穷举排列试验和2,160次脚本化多步试验，并开展全状态日志审计。

Result: 联合策略在固定优先级下空间顺序不变，但保守拒绝在六智能体门口任务中仅完成31.25%，随机票为90.28%，配对提升59.03个百分点（95%自助区间50.00-68.06）。所有策略保留测试的空间约束，优先级仲裁仍错过独立小实例最优。日志审计精确重放156个检查点并拒绝1,332个构造损坏。

Conclusion: 证据涉及执行语义，而非人类现实性或长期公平性。

Abstract: Concurrent actions in large language model (LLM) agent environments require arbitration even when each proposal is individually valid. We implement a typed snapshot-settlement contract and audit three distinct properties: order sensitivity, useful progress, and replay consistency. Five settlement policies are tested in 28,800 exhaustive permutation trials and 2,160 scripted multistep episodes. Joint policies are spatially order-invariant conditional on fixed priorities, yet conservative rejection completes only 31.25% of agents in a six-agent doorway task versus 90.28% for random tickets; the paired improvement is 59.03 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval: 50.00-68.06). All policies preserve the tested spatial constraints, and priority arbitration still misses the independent small-instance optimum. A separate full-state journal audit exactly replays 156 checkpoints and rejects 1,332 constructed corruptions with a retained terminal anchor. The evidence concerns execution semantics, not human realism or long-run fairness.

</details>


### [374] [ReSolve: Reusing Candidate Reasoning through Selective Generative Moderation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01140)
*Bangji Yang,Jiajun Fan,Hongba Ma,Xi Zhu,Weizhi Zhang,Minghao Guo,Ye Li,Hamid Palangi,Jiaxuan You*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ReSolve是一个免训练推理流程，通过选择性生成调节复用候选推理过程，在数学竞赛题上以更少token取得更高正确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多解采样会把计算浪费在中间推导和未完成论证上，作者希望复用这些候选推理而非仅用于投票。

Method: 引入答案分布控制器：当候选答案分歧或无法解析时，调用模型检查已有推导，并将生成的解纳入有界循环；采用Hybrid评分。

Result: 在130道竞赛数学题、两个独立候选池上，ReSolve得100和99题正确，投票为91和92；八样本自一致得94和96但token更多，ReSolve分别少用46.3%和47.2% token。去除可见推导的消融降至93题正确。

Conclusion: 支持候选推理作为可复用推理计算；但未证明其相对额外采样的准确率优势，也未证明专门路由指令的独特收益。

Abstract: Sampling multiple solutions spends computation on intermediate deductions and unfinished arguments as well as final answers. We introduce ReSolve, a training-free inference procedure that reuses this candidate reasoning through selective generative moderation. An answer-distribution controller invokes a model to examine existing derivations when candidates disagree or lack a parseable answer, then incorporates the generated solution into a bounded loop. Under Hybrid scoring on 130 competition-mathematics problems evaluated with two independently sampled candidate pools, ReSolve obtains 100 and 99 correct answers, compared with 91 and 92 for voting over the same four candidates, with no correct-to-incorrect changes relative to that vote in either pool. Eight-sample self-consistency obtains 94 and 96 correct answers while consuming substantially more tokens; ReSolve uses 46.3% and 47.2% fewer tokens in the two evaluations. A controlled ablation removes visible derivations while retaining answer keys, vote counts, and the per-state output-cap rule, reducing accuracy from 100 to 93 correct despite increasing computation. Selective and always-on Uniform moderation both solve 97 problems, while selectivity reduces moderation tokens by approximately 54% and total pipeline tokens by 6.2%. These results support candidate reasoning as reusable inference computation. They do not establish an accuracy advantage over additional sampling or a distinct benefit from specialized route instructions.

</details>


### [375] [When Does Exercise-Specific Joint Selection Help? An Audit of Evaluation and Control Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01188)
*Haotian Chen,Jingkun Yu,Yuning Zhang,Bowen Ye*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文是一项探索性审计，检验基于骨架的动作正确性分类中"关节选择"增益的真实性，发现增益高度依赖于评估聚合方式与子集结构控制，并非稳健的新算法或临床获益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前研究声称"针对特定动作选择关节"能改进基于骨架的正确性分类，但其增益是否真实、稳健尚不明确，可能受评估聚合方式与子集结构等混杂因素影响。

Method: 审计REHAB24-6中10名受试者的1,057次重复动作，分解出评估聚合方式、子集结构与时间表示三个因素。对比pooled out-of-fold AUROC与等权within-person AUROC两种估计量，并构建1,000个维度匹配的随机映射作为对照，分别控制双侧结构与躯干纳入等条件；另用RBF-SVM、逻辑回归及随机卷积比较器进行对照，并加入序列顺序与配对种子控制。

Result: 手动子集kNN增益从pooled out-of-fold AUROC的0.055降至等权within-person AUROC的0.020，两者配对区间均包含零。1,000个随机映射中有14个达到或超过手动pooled结果，若同时匹配双侧结构与躯干纳入则有145个。RBF-SVM在within-person估计量下保持正增益，而逻辑回归与随机卷积比较器为负增益点估计。

Conclusion: 关节选择的增益并非稳健，取决于估计量选择与结构适当的对照，不能据此建立新算法或临床效益；相关主张必须明确估计量并采用结构匹配的对照。

Abstract: Exercise-specific joint selection can improve skeleton-based correctness classification, but what does that gain establish? We audit 1,057 repetitions from ten REHAB24-6 subjects, separating evaluation aggregation, subset structure, and temporal representation. The manual-subset kNN gain changes from 0.055 for pooled out-of-fold AUROC to 0.020 for equal-weight within-person AUROC; both paired intervals include zero. Among 1,000 dimension-matched random maps, 14 match or exceed the manual pooled result, versus 145 when bilateral structure and trunk inclusion are also matched. RBF-SVM retains a positive within-person gain, whereas logistic regression and a random-convolution comparator have negative point gains under that estimand. Sequence-order and paired-seed controls further qualify the interpretation. This exploratory audit shows why joint-selection claims require explicit estimands and structurally appropriate controls; it does not establish a new algorithm or clinical benefit.

</details>


### [376] [Federated Agent Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01195)
*Qiang Yang,Zhiqiang Kou,Xueyi Zhang,Dong-Dong Wu,Hanlin Gu,Jing Guo,Yang Liu,Di Jiang,Qian Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"联邦Agent优化(FAO)"问题，研究分布式LLM Agent如何在隐私约束下通过受控信息交换协同提升能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM Agent在私有环境中积累的经验因隐私与产权约束无法直接共享，而传统联邦学习仅聚焦模型参数，无法覆盖Agent的多种能力维度。

Method: 将FAO形式化为多目标问题，平衡Agent效用、隐私泄露与通信开销；在策略、记忆、工具使用、奖励、结构化知识与技能五个维度上组织优化空间，并刻画私有经验抽象、保护、聚合与适配为可迁移能力的过程。

Result: 提出统一的FAO框架与优化空间划分，给出Agent间间接互益的系统性视角，并识别关键挑战。

Conclusion: 呼吁研究可信联邦Agent系统，列出若干未来研究方向。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate in private environments and accumulate valuable experience from task execution, tool use, feedback, and local knowledge. Yet such experience is distributed across organizations and cannot be directly shared because of privacy and proprietary constraints. Conventional federated learning is insufficient for this setting, as agent capabilities extend beyond model parameters to memory, tools, rewards, skills, and structured knowledge. In this paper, we formulate \textbf{Federated Agent Optimization (FAO)}, which studies how distributed agents can collaboratively improve through controlled information exchange while keeping raw data, complete trajectories, and private knowledge local. We define FAO as a multi-objective problem balancing agent utility, privacy leakage, and communication cost, and organize its optimization space across policy, memory, tool use, reward, and structured knowledge and skills. We further characterize how private experience can be abstracted, protected, aggregated, and adapted into transferable capabilities, providing a unified view of how agents can benefit from one another without direct experience sharing. Finally, we identify the key challenges of FAO and outline several promising directions for future research toward trustworthy federated agent systems.

</details>


### [377] [Dependency-Aware Reward Shaping for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01207)
*Ziyi Chen,Yan Zhang,Jianhui Wei,Daoan Zhang,Zuozhu Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DARS，用谓词依赖图对失败轨迹分配步级信用，显著提升LLM强化学习多任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 终端奖励对失败episode中所有步骤归零，无法区分有效步骤与建立在错误上的无效步骤，导致信用分配不合理。

Method: 将任务进度表示为带前置依赖的谓词图；标注每步验证/失效/修复的谓词；验证谓词按到最近破坏前置的图距离衰减，独立谓词不受影响；修复更新权重，失效谓词需重新验证；用固定势函数转成带符号步奖励，通过通用接口集成GiGPO、ARPO/AEPO等。

Result: 五个任务族、1.5B–8B模型上成功率最高提升10点(ALFWorld)，提升WebShop与Search-R1 QA，补充AEPO在AIME24/25表现，超越OmniOPD；消融显示步级信用、依赖衰减、图拓扑均有贡献；8B蒸馏标注器可媲美API标注器。

Conclusion: DARS通过依赖感知奖励塑造有效区分有效与无效步骤，可即插即用于多种训练方法，且无需前沿模型裁判即可高效运行。

Abstract: When training large language models with reinforcement learning, terminal rewards provide little guidance about which steps matter. Common methods for assigning step credit overlook that work built on uncorrected mistakes is wasted while independent work remains valid. With only a final success/failure reward, every step in a failed episode has zero total future reward, even when it made progress. We propose Dependency-Aware Reward Shaping (DARS), which represents task progress as predicates linked by prerequisite relations and assigns step-level credit over the dependency graph. An annotator marks which predicates each step verifies, invalidates, or repairs. Verified predicates are discounted according to graph distance from the nearest broken prerequisite, while independent predicates are unaffected. Repairs update these weights based on any errors that remain; invalidated predicates need re-verification to regain credit. A fixed potential converts these annotations into signed per-step rewards. A common reward and annotation interface allows DARS to integrate with a range of reasoning and agentic training methods, such as GiGPO and ARPO/AEPO, without changing their rollout strategies or optimizers. Across five task families and models from 1.5B to 8B, DARS improves success by up to 10 points over GiGPO trained with the same budget and harness (ALFWorld), raises the WebShop task score and Search-R1 QA accuracy, complements AEPO's entropy-based training on AIME24/25 with a Python interpreter, and exceeds OmniOPD in controlled tool-free reasoning comparisons at 1.7B and 4B. Ablations show that step-level credit, dependency attenuation, and graph topology each contribute. On ALFWorld, a distilled 8B annotator matches the API annotator, enabling DARS to run efficiently without a frontier judge. Code is available at https://github.com/JianhuiWei7/DARS.

</details>


### [378] [Reputation, Strategy, and Emotion Effects on Generative AI Cooperation: A Comparison Across Reasoning and Non-Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01222)
*Celso de Melo,Zishan Feng,James Hale,Kazunori Terada,Giorgio Coricelli,Jonathan Gratch*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究用迭代囚徒困境考察前沿生成式AI的合作行为，操纵对手声誉、策略（勒索 vs. 慷慨）与情绪信号。非推理模型受三因素系统影响，推理模型则更依赖策略与声誉，情绪作用变为条件性，且末轮行为异质，揭示模型可被利用的差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI在具有经济与社会影响的交互中承担日益自主的角色，因此理解其合作倾向及影响该倾向的信号至关重要。研究借鉴人类行为研究范式，检验AI是否以及在多大程度上像人类一样对社会线索作出反应。

Method: 采用迭代囚徒困境实验，操纵三个变量：对手声誉（正面/未知/负面）、对手策略（勒索 vs. 慷慨）、非言语情绪信号（传达竞争或合作评价的面部表情）。研究一测试非推理模型（Claude 3.5、Gemini 2.0 Flash、GPT-4o）；研究二测试推理模型（Claude 4.6、Gemini 3、GPT-5.2），并加入诊断性的"和谐博弈"以检测"波将金效应"。

Result: 非推理模型中，合作被三个因素系统塑造，与人类研究长期记录的模式平行，但各模型对因素权重差异显著。推理模型更集中依赖策略与声誉，几乎消除了非推理模型中的波将金效应（和谐博弈中合作近乎一致），情绪只起条件性作用，符合层级线索加权策略而非社会敏感性丧失。推理模型末轮行为异质，从持续合作到系统性末轮背叛，显示各模型可被利用性不同。

Conclusion: 生成式AI正成为日益复杂但异质的社会行为体。研究凸显制定标准化合作基准的价值，以指导Gen AI在谈判等多轮交互场景中的负责任部署。

Abstract: As generative AI (Gen AI) systems take on increasingly autonomous roles in economically and socially consequential interactions, understanding their propensity to cooperate -- and the signals that shape this propensity -- has become essential. We examine cooperative behavior in frontier Gen AI models using the iterated prisoner's dilemma, manipulating counterpart reputation (positive, unknown, negative), strategy (extortion vs. generosity), and non-verbal emotional signaling (facial expressions conveying competitive or cooperative appraisals). In a first study with non-reasoning models (Claude 3.5, Gemini 2.0 Flash, GPT-4o), cooperation was systematically shaped by all three factors, paralleling patterns long documented in human behavioral research, though models varied substantially in how heavily each factor was weighted. A second study with reasoning models (Claude 4.6, Gemini 3, GPT-5.2) revealed a more concentrated reliance on strategy and reputation, a near-elimination of the Potemkin effect observed in non-reasoning models (evidenced by near-uniform cooperation in a diagnostic harmony game), and a more conditional role for emotion consistent with a hierarchical cue-weighting strategy rather than a simple loss of social sensitivity. Reasoning models also showed heterogeneous end-game behavior, ranging from sustained cooperation to systematic last-round defection effect, revealing model-specific exploitability profiles with direct practical relevance for deployment in negotiation and other multi-round interactions. Together, these findings characterize Gen AI models as increasingly sophisticated, though heterogeneous, social actors, and underscore the practical value of developing standardized cooperation benchmarks to inform the responsible deployment of Gen AI in interactive, socially consequential settings.

</details>


### [379] [HHR: Hierarchical Hash Retrieval for Efficient LLM Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01230)
*Lianjun Liu,Tiantian Zheng,You Huang,Weiqi Yan,Mingte Qiu,Huazhong Liu,Xiaofeng Zhu,Yunshan Zhong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出分层哈希检索(HHR)框架，通过粗到细的两阶段方法解决哈希检索中汉明距离与注意力相关性失配问题，提升长上下文推理效率与精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文推理是LLM的关键瓶颈。哈希检索虽高效（二值编码+汉明距离），但存在关键失配：Query-Key logits同时依赖方向相似度和特征幅度，而哈希二值化丢弃了幅度信息，导致低logit键的假阳性检索和高logit键的假阴性遗漏。

Method: HHR采用粗到细框架，包含两部分：(1) 几何感知键路由(GKR)，学习逐头的正交变换来重新分配特征幅度，推导更具区分度的页级logit边界，从而剪除低logit键并保留重要候选；(2) 学习哈希投影(LHP)，学习逐头投影空间，使汉明距离与真实Query-Key相关性排序对齐，实现细粒度检索。

Result: 在多种LLM和基准上优于现有方法。LongBench上平均分提升1.10分；128K上下文下，Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct实现最高3.30x解码加速和2.83x端到端加速。

Conclusion: 结合GKR与LHP，HHR有效抑制假阳性并恢复假阴性，显著提升哈希稀疏注意力的保真度。

Abstract: Efficient long-context inference is essential for large language models (LLMs), yet it poses a severe computational bottleneck. Hash-based retrieval offers an efficient alternative by encoding queries and keys into binary codes and using Hamming distance for key selection. However, this leads to a critical mismatch between Hamming distance and attention relevance. Query-Key logits depend jointly on directional similarity and feature magnitudes, whereas hash binarization discards magnitude information, causing both false-positive retrieval of low-logit keys and false-negative omission of high-logit keys. To address these failures, we propose Hierarchical Hash Retrieval (HHR), a coarse-to-fine framework that progressively improves retrieval accuracy through Geometry-Aware Key Routing (GKR) and Learned Hash Projection (LHP). GKR learns a head-wise orthogonal transformation to redistribute feature magnitudes and derive more discriminative page-level logit bounds, enabling effective pruning of low-logit keys while preserving important candidates. LHP then learns a head-wise projection space that aligns Hamming distance with the true Query-Key relevance ranking for fine-grained retrieval. By combining GKR and LHP, HHR suppresses false positives and recovers false negatives, substantially improving the fidelity of hash-based sparse attention. Extensive experiments across diverse LLMs and benchmarks demonstrate that HHR achieves superior performance over existing methods. For example, on LongBench, HHR improves the average score by 1.10 points and, at a context length of 128K, achieves up to a 3.30x decoding speedup and a 2.83x end-to-end speedup for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/lianjunl13-sudo/HHR.

</details>


### [380] [Learning to Ask: Information Acquisition for SLM-LLM Collaboration, under a budget](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01236)
*Yongjun Kim,Xiaoxiao Li,Jaeho Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 将SLM-LLM协作建模为API预算约束下的信息获取问题，用三阶段RLVR框架让SLM按需向黑盒LLM发起针对性查询，提升性能-成本权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SLM-LLM协作多被视作计算分配问题（决定谁处理推理的哪部分），但在黑盒API场景下，粗粒度委派或跨模型切换时重复传上下文导致效率低下。

Method: 将协作重新表述为信息获取问题：SLM作为主推理器，仅在需要时向黑盒LLM顾问发起针对性查询，而非委派推理本身。提出三阶段RLVR框架，学习是否调用顾问、如何构造有用查询、以及如何将协作整合进推理过程，联合优化顾问调用与信息利用。

Result: 在数学推理与编程任务上，方法在性能-成本权衡上优于现有协作基线，部分设置下匹配或超过问题级oracle路由；并可无需额外训练迁移到其他顾问模型家族。

Conclusion: SLM-LLM协作可从计算分配转向信息获取，通过RLVR学习按需查询黑盒顾问，实现高效且可迁移的协作。

Abstract: Collaboration between a small language model (SLM) and a large language model (LLM) offers an opportunity to combine the efficiency of smaller models with the strong reasoning capabilities of larger ones. Existing approaches primarily frame such collaboration as a computation allocation problem, determining which model should handle each portion of the reasoning process. In black-box API-based settings, however, this paradigm can be inefficient due to coarse-grained delegation or repeated transmission of context across model switches. In this work, we instead formulate SLM-LLM collaboration as an information acquisition problem, under an API budget constraint. The SLM remains the primary reasoner and selectively queries a black-box LLM advisor only when needed, issuing targeted queries rather than delegating the reasoning process itself. To realize this strategy, we develop a three-stage RLVR framework that learns whether to call the advisor, how to formulate useful queries, and how to integrate the collaboration into the reasoning process by jointly refining advisor invocation and information use. Across mathematical reasoning and coding tasks, our approach improves the performance--cost tradeoff over existing collaboration baselines and, in some settings, matches or exceeds oracle problem-level routing. Finally, we show that our strategy can transfer to other advisor model families, without further training.

</details>


### [381] [Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graphs for Dynamic Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01249)
*Yan Luo,Selim-Antoine Lali,Jeremy Moebel,Iliass Khoutaibi,Ahmadou Aidara,Mengyu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出“动态任务路由”问题，并用六个基准构建大规模动态查询数据集，提出RIAG多智能体策略以平衡重算成本与陈旧结论风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统推理协议任务固定且预先选择，无法测试智能体是否能传播相关更新、保留未受影响工作或重建历史任务绑定。

Method: 将MMLU、MMLU-Pro、MedMCQA、MATH、GPQA和HumanEval重构成31,119个动态片段、373,428个按时间分类的查询；提出Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graph（RIAG），分离确定性时间解析与任务推理，按不可变文档身份缓存解答，新任务先进行两次未暴露尝试，有条件调用审计与修复，每个文档版本最多四次调用。

Result: 同质RIAG达到54.24%联合路由与回答准确率，0.62次调用/查询；最强对比方法为32.22%，18.00次调用/查询。异质RIAG为49.78%，0.63次调用/查询。

Conclusion: RIAG能在大幅降低调用成本的同时显著提升动态任务路由与回答准确率，优于高成本对比方法。

Abstract: Conventional reasoning protocols present a fixed, preselected task, so they cannot test whether an agent propagates relevant updates, preserves unaffected work, or reconstructs a historical task binding. We therefore study \emph{dynamic task routing}, in which an event stream revises task bindings and a system must select the document version valid at each query time before solving it. To study this problem, we repurpose six widely used benchmarks: MMLU, MMLU-Pro, MedMCQA, MATH, GPQA, and HumanEval into 31{,}119 dynamic episodes comprising 373{,}428 temporally categorized queries. This setting exposes a central trade-off: recomputing after every event wastes work, whereas unguarded reuse returns stale conclusions. We introduce the Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graph (RIAG), a bounded multi-agent policy that separates deterministic temporal resolution from task reasoning. RIAG caches solutions by immutable document identity, starts each fresh task with two unexposed attempts, and conditionally invokes audit and repair, using at most four calls per document version. On this collection, homogeneous RIAG achieves 54.24\% joint routing-and-answer accuracy at 0.62 calls/query, compared with 32.22\% at 18.00 calls/query for the strongest comparison method; heterogeneous RIAG reaches 49.78\% at 0.63 calls/query.

</details>


### [382] [DeFA: Dependency-Guided Failure Attribution for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01256)
*Bo Deng,Xinlei Zheng,Yi Wei,Kang Zhou,Chongyang Tao,Renzhao Liang,Xuanren Chen,Lifan Guo,Chi Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DeFA是一个依赖引导的LLM智能体故障归因框架，通过构建事件依赖图和故障传播图定位决定性错误，在多数据集和多模态场景下达到最优准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体执行中，错误与其可见后果之间往往相隔很多步骤，导致决定性错误的定位需要同时理解步骤内容与步骤依赖关系，现有方法难以应对。

Method: 1) 将协议关系与语义依赖结合，构建覆盖整个轨迹的事件依赖图；2) 识别可能违反任务要求的事件，追踪其来源与后续影响，构建故障传播图；3) 结合步骤证据与步骤在故障传播中的角色，定位决定性错误、责任智能体与错误类别；4) 将执行分段，结合当前段详细内容与其他段摘要，缓解长轨迹问题。

Result: 在Who and When及其Pro文本子集上，所有评估骨干模型均取得最高的责任智能体与精确步骤准确率，Pro上在分类对齐方法中故障模式准确率最高；在图像与视频轨迹上验证了多模态适用性；消融实验支持分段、事件依赖图与故障传播图的贡献；用于Trace2Skill技能演化时下游任务准确率提升6-15个百分点。

Conclusion: DeFA能有效定位智能体故障根因，并可作为诊断反馈支持智能体在后续任务中的持续改进。

Abstract: Errors in LLM agent executions and their visible consequences can be separated by many steps, making decisive-error localization a matter of understanding both step content and step dependencies. We introduce DeFA, a dependency-guided framework for agent failure attribution. DeFA first combines protocol relations and semantic dependencies into an event dependency graph spanning the trajectory. It then identifies events that may violate task requirements and traces their sources and subsequent effects to construct a failure propagation graph. Finally, DeFA uses step evidence and the steps' roles in failure propagation to identify the decisive error, responsible agent, and error category. To support long trajectories, DeFA partitions executions into segments and combines the current segment's detailed content with summaries of the other segments, giving local diagnosis access to global execution context. Across Who and When and the Who and When Pro text subset, DeFA achieves the highest responsible-agent and exact step accuracy with all evaluated backbones, and the highest failure-mode accuracy among taxonomy-aligned methods on Pro. Further experiments on image and video trajectories demonstrate its applicability to multimodal failure attribution. Ablations support the contributions of segmentation, the event dependency graph, and the failure propagation graph. Using DeFA's diagnostic feedback for skill evolution in Trace2Skill improves downstream task accuracy by 6-15 percentage points over the native pipeline, showing that the diagnoses can also support agent improvement on subsequent tasks.

</details>


### [383] [Feedback Without the Wait: Piloting a Generative AI Practice Platform in a Large Maths Class](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01262)
*Lili Chen,Gavin Buskes,Yuxin Ren,Chin Tong Leong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 设计并试点一个GenAI练习平台，在自主学习时提供即时、支架式反馈，将人工监督从事中评分前移到事前解验证，以化解反馈即时性与可信度之间的矛盾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大班电气工程课师生比高，学生卡住需等数天才能获得反馈；GenAI能扩展对话式反馈，但用于批改考核作业引发信任与问责问题，而保留人工环节又重蹈延迟覆辙。核心矛盾：即时性 vs 可信度。

Method: 设计并试点一个GenAI练习平台，在学生自主练习过程中提供即时、分步引导（scaffolded）反馈；将人工监督从实时评分重新定位到对解答的事前验证。
